title: K-Pop Puzzle Hunters
description: K-Pop Puzzle Hunters is a fun and creative puzzle game inspired by the K-Pop Demon Hunters universe where you get to piece together 12 stunning images featuring Huntrix, Saja Boys, and Derpy Tiger. Choose your challenge with 16, 36, 64, or 100 puzzle pieces and use hints when needed. Perfect for K-Pop fans, anime lovers, and puzzle enthusiasts, this free game mixes strategy, logic, and fandom fun. Start solving today and become the ultimate Puzzle Hunter!

title: Idle Legend
description: Dive into an exciting world! Fight monsters, gather battle energy, unlock bosses, and defeat them to earn coins. Spend coins on upgrades, skins, and pets. Enjoy vibrant cartoon graphics and exciting quests. Start your adventure today!

title: Dog Merge Mania
description: Merge cute puppies! Unlock breeds & grow your own fluffy dog paradise! A Relaxing Escape: The perfect mix of chill gameplay and light strategy.

title: Hyper Nurse: Hospital Games
description: Get ready to navigate through the fast-paced world of healthcare, where every second counts. Your mission as a hyper nurse is to provide exceptional care to patients, manage critical situations, and ensure the smooth operation of the hospital. Get ready to put your multitasking skills to the test as you juggle multiple tasks and make crucial decisions in hyper nurse: hospital games.

title: Golf Orbit
description:
One shot golf simulator is the battle of golf rivals to become the golf king worldwide. Become part of this idle golf orbit rocket league in which balls go high to Mars. Smash the ball to mars and become the golf champions.

Oneshot Golf Orbit is golf offline game which has many golf rocket leagues and one shot golf battles. Be part Mars golf games to become champions of golfing over it.

title: Autumn Glam Gala
description: Get ready for the ultimate fall beauty adventure at the Autumn Glam Gala! Help three BFFs create stunning makeup looks for the most anticipated gala of the season. From soft, natural tones to bold, sparkling colors, you’ll have endless fun choosing makeup, hairstyles, and glamorous outfits. Experiment with fall-inspired looks and fashion trends to ensure each girl shines at the gala. Are you ready to showcase your makeup artist skills? Play Autumn Glam Gala now and let the glam begin!

title: Toco Teens Halloween Party
description:
Step into the spooky fun world of Toca Teens Halloween Party, a fashionable Halloween dress-up game made just for style lovers! ?
Join the Toca teens as they get ready for the most glamorous Halloween event of the year. Choose from eerie yet elegant outfits, haunting accessories, and bold makeup looks to create the perfect spooky-chic style.

title: Ultimate Tower Defense
description: Ultimate Tower Defense is an exciting strategy game that perfectly blends tower defense, battle, and fast-paced action into one addictive experience. In the game, you must carefully protect defense towers and deploy powerful heroes to stop endless waves of enemies. Each tower has unique attack abilities. Select your preferred mode to begin the challenge.

title: Dragon Year Jigsaw
description: Dive into the lively universe of 'Dragon Year Jigsaw,' a comical online puzzle game set in the Chinese Dragon Year. Solve 24 levels of dragon-themed jigsaw puzzles, featuring vibrant and playful comic art. Perfect for puzzle lovers and those seeking a whimsical online experience. Join the fun – start piecing together your dragon adventure now!

title: Block Up
description: Block Up Contrast is a minimalist arcade game where you need a moving block upward through an endless series of obstacles. The challenge is to avoid barriers of contrasting colors while collecting points. The game requires precise timing and quick reflexes as the speed increases. With simple yet engaging gameplay, Block Up Contrast offers an addictive experience for players.

title: World War Brothers WW2
description:
⭐WORLD WAR BROTHERS⭐
World war brothers is a ww2 online first person shooter game. Play with your friends destroy enemy bases, capture the points. Traditional weapons, maps, and more will add soon. We need your feedbacks.
⭐ Features ⭐
- PvP multiplayer 8v8 Allies vs. Axis Teams
- Daily missions will come soon
- Omaha Beach, Pacific maps

title: Number Tricky Puzzles
description: Thanks for visiting Number Tricky Puzzles, an addictive casual puzzle game. Your goal is to categorize identical coins into a slot and then click the merge button to combine them into higher-level coins. Keep merging coins and trying to evolve to see if you can reach the coveted level 10! You can challenge yourself to become the master of coin evolution! Beautiful graphics and animations bring you more fun.

title: Cosmic Aviator
description: Embark on an exhilarating journey through the depths of the cosmos in Cosmic Aviator! In this pulse-pounding arcade-style game, you find yourself piloting a sleek aircraft that's trapped within a twisting and treacherous tunnel of unknown origin. Your mission? Navigate through the endless labyrinth of obstacles and hazards while collecting valuable power-ups to boost your score to new heights.

title: Free the Ball
description: Try out Free the Ball, a super fun puzzle game! Your job is to guide the ball to its goal by moving blocks around. And get this – there are a whopping three thousand levels to play, and they're all free! No need to buy anything.

title: Archery Master - Bow and Arrow
description:
Join archery adventure and become a bowmaster! Aim, shoot and hit the bullseye!

Pick your bow, defeat other archery masters and don’t let them take you down! Join in this fun and challenging adventure and have fun. Bow masters can really challenge your casual game skills but have no fear! If you enjoy bow and arrow games, then prepare to defeat other bow masters, earn coins, score, and become the ultimate bow master!

title: Barbee Summer Vacation
description: Summer’s here, and it’s time for Barbee and her besties to enjoy their dream vacation! In Barbee Summer Vacation, you’ll help each character get ready with stylish warm-weather outfits, fun accessories, and fresh summer vibes. Whether it’s flowy dresses, sunglasses, or floral tops, it’s all about picking looks that scream sunshine.

title: Challenge Your Friends
description: Challenge yourself! With seven different games, you can experience thrilling moments whether you're playing solo or competing against your friends. Drunken Duel, Tug The Table, Stick Duel, Milk The Cow, and many more games are waiting for you! Plus, to make the competition even more fun, you can choose exciting dares to make  the matches unforgettable! For those who prefer solo play, 6 games are ready to keep you entertained! Step into this world of fun and enjoy the thrill of competition!

title: Zoo Shap
description:
Are you ready to put your brain to the test? ZooShap: Puzzle Game is a thrilling blend of logic, deduction, and strategy that challenges you to push your critical thinking and problem-solving skills to new heights.
Use your wit and a touch of luck to solve puzzles made up of 24 unique shape-color combinations called Shaplors. Your goal is to guess the correct answer key by selecting five Shaplors from the grid.

title: Jail Prison Van Police Game
description:
Get ready for action-packed gameplay! Take on the role of a police officer, drive the prison van, and ensure the secure transport of criminals in this exciting Police Bus Game

Immerse yourself in the intense world of law enforcement with the Jail Prison Van Police Game. Assume the role of a dedicated police officer tasked with transporting high-profile criminals in a specially designed prison van.

title: Tile Connect Club
description: Tile Connect Club is a brain-training game that tests your linking skills. You have to connect tiles with different pictures in pairs and clear them all within a limited time. You can enjoy various pictures on the tiles, such as animals, fruits, flowers, and more. You can also play faster and faster to become a tile master. Tile Connect Club is a fun and addictive game that challenges your mind and eyes. If you are looking for some tile-connecting action, then download Tile Connect Club now!

title: Burger Cafe - Cooking Games For Kids
description: Learn to cook burgers and open your own restaurant! Choose a recipe, gather fresh ingredients, chop veggies, prepare signature sauces, bake buns to perfection, and fry juicy patties. Once everything’s ready, assemble your burger masterpiece, package it, and serve happy customers. Customize your restaurant’s look and unlock new recipes as you rise to become a top chef in town. Dive into the burger-making experience and build the best burger joint around!

title: Boxteria
description:
Dive into an amazing cubic world, where you can become anyone from a BANDIT to a ZOMBIE attacking everyone around! Imagine having 20 super cool cars at your disposal to ride, drift, and have fun on maps like "Russian Village," and "Courtyard," spaces filled with adventures.

You'll enjoy creating characters, each unique in their own way. You can assemble a team of bandits, zombies, or even police officers and engage in thrilling battles or cool races.

title: The Earth Evolution
description: The Earth: Evolution is a relaxing placement game. What does your fantasy planet look like? You can use beautiful objects to decorate and build your unique planet in different areas of the universe. Collect sunlight by placing buildings and when you have enough sunlight, you get more resources needed to build your planet. Escape from the stressful daily life for a few minutes or even longer!

title: Cat Rescue
description: Protect the cat from dragon invasions through strategic sort puzzle combat. As enemies display colored patterns, your cannon must sort puzzle sequences to match their hues. Click the correctly colored cannon to obliterate matching dragon sections. Each precise cannon shot slows their advance toward the cat! Repeat until dragon threats vanish, but remember: rescue missions demand speed and sort puzzle accuracy!

title: Survival in Area 51
description: You will play as the character Stas, who works in Area 51. One day, Stas was given a strange task, to find acid and pour it into an unusual device. Then something terrible happened... In Area 51, an explosion occurred underground, and zombies appeared. They began to attack scientists and guards. Your task is to destroy zombies, mercenaries and find a way out of this terrible underground place. The game offers shooting, simple puzzles, a plot, many locations and a final battle.

title: Tunnel Road
description: Tunnel Road is an adrenaline-filled arcade game that requires quick reflexes, sharp focus and a great visual reaction! Keep up with the speed, avoid obstacles and cover the longest distance while advancing in a colorful and dynamic tunnel!

title: Super Stock Stack
description: Super Stock Stack challenges you to sort food cans onto shelves with speed and clever organization! Match the cans by their labels, manage the growing stock, and test your skills as the levels get tougher. Can you become the ultimate stock master?

title: Ninja Obby Parkour
description:
Step into the thrilling world of Ninja Obby Parkour, where every level is a test of speed, agility, and strategy. Packed with hundreds of unique obstacle courses, this game combines competitive racing with ninja-style combat and dazzling customization options.

From smashing glass doors at checkpoints with your ninja power to unlocking powerful bonuses like speed boost, giant mode, and flight, every run feels fresh.

title: Bomb Evolution
description: Bomb Evolution is a cannon-shooting arcade game. On the mysterious and mist-shrouded island, you have the opportunity to strategically establish not one, but three main bases, bolstered by an additional rocket. Engage in an enthralling battle against a formidable opponent, both of you operating under identical circumstances. Your ultimate objective: obliterating all the enemy's main bases positioned on the neighboring fog-laden island. May victory in this war be your prized accomplishment!

title: Challenger City Driver
description: Get ready to skid the wheels of a stunning muscle through an expansive morning city map! Customize and upgrade your sports car with cool upgradables and become the best driver in the city. Take your dog with you in 3 driving challenges and conquer the missions together. Use nitro to beat slow traffic and beat all speed, stunt and drift triggers spread across the map. Are you ready to show your driving skills? Prove yourself!

title: Bubbly Lab
description: Bubbly Lab is a physics puzzle game where you have to catch all the adorable bubbles in the laboratory. Use a super strong vacuum cleaner to get the bubbles into the flask. Use your logic to move lab items to help you get bubbles. Solve interesting puzzles in this fun and unique game!

title: Catch The Pig
description: This is a casual elimination game. The main purpose of the game is to find three identical pigs, catch them, and collect all the pig collections!

title: Find & Steal Brainrot: 67 Game
description: Find & Steal Brainrot: 67 Game is a chaotic puzzle hunt where you track a target brainrot through surreal, meme-soaked worlds. Each level pushes you to spot the same creature across dense, absurd scenes packed with icons like 67, Strawberry Elephant, Dragon Cannelloni, Spaghetti Tualetti, and La Supreme Combinasion. Fast-paced scanning, wild details, and pure internet nonsense create a frantic, high-energy experience for fans of intense spotting and brainrot chaos.

title: Bubble Shooter Panda Blast
description:
Step into the colorful world of Panda Blast, where your mission is to rescue baby pandas by popping bubbles. Mama Panda needs your help to bring her lost cubs home. With vibrant graphics, charming animations, and exciting puzzles, this game is perfect for all ages.
Match three or more bubbles to clear them, free trapped pandas, and progress through hundreds of fun levels. Use powerful boosters, enjoy daily rewards, and experience smooth animations that bring the adventure to life.

title: Mad Truck
description: Are you good at challenging the balanced platforms and ramps? Mad Truck provides you with a driving simulation game. In the Level mode, you need to keep the car stable at the side. In the challenge Level mode, you can drive the car to overpass different obstacles at the normal view. All levels require players to reach the finish line as soon as possible. If you can complete the level at the marked time, you can win all 3 yellow stars.

title: Jigsolitaire
description: Step into a peaceful world of beautiful images made from gentle, carefully crafted blocks. Jigsolitaire is a game you’ll want to return to every day: it helps you unwind, disconnect from stress, and enjoy a small moment of calm just for yourself. Each level reveals a new scene - warm landscapes, charming cottages, delicate nature details, and quiet corners you’ll love exploring piece by piece.

title: Doge Match
description: Welcome to Doge Match, a delightful and addictive puzzle game that will keep you entertained for hours! With 36 meticulously crafted levels, Doge Match offers a unique and challenging experience for players of all ages.

title: BrutalMania.io (Brutal Mania)
description: BrutalMania.io (Brutal Mania) is an online gladiator IO action game where you are armed with savage weapons with a straightforward mission to take down every rival gladiator in sight. The battles are brutal, the carnage is real, and only the strongest will survive.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Oreplication
description: Sandbox strategy tycoon where you design factories for infinite wealth. Start with basic droppers & conveyors, upgrade to advanced machines. Deep progression, mystery boxes, endless optimization—build, outsmart, ascend in the ultimate factory challenge!

title: Color Sand Puzzle
description: Welcome to Color Sand Puzzle! Relax and unwind with Color Sand Puzzle, a refreshing take on the classic block puzzle game! Your mission is simple yet fun—fill the grid with matching colors of sand to clear and control the lines. As colorful sand blocks fall from the top, you’ll need to strategically arrange them to form complete horizontal rows. When the sand lines up from left to right, they disappear, and you earn points!

title: Sum Shuffle
description: Sum Shuffle is a puzzle game where players combine numbers to reach a target sum for each level. With both positive and negative numbers, players must strategically select and merge them. The game offers 50 levels, progressing in difficulty. Early levels are easy for beginners, but the complexity increases to challenge experienced puzzle enthusiasts. With smooth transitions and immersive sound effects, Sum Shuffle delivers an entertaining experience suitable for players of all ages.

title: Merge Combo
description: Immerse yourself in this captivating merge puzzle game! Combine matching blocks to score points and trigger epic combos. The more blocks you merge, the bigger the numbers and combos grow! Test your strategy and aim for the highest score—how large a number can you create?

title: Checkers Deluxe Edition
description:
It's a clash on the battlefield! Draw up your plan and defeat your opponents with finesse!

It is also known as the draughts game, and it is an interesting test of strategy. Compete with an opponent and dominate their pieces as best you can.

What happens when you manage to move a piece to the other end? Come play now and let's find out!

title: Relax Mini Games Collection
description: This is a collection of creative and fun mini-games. The game contains a variety of modes, you can DIY ice cream, have cooking for mooncakes, design a car of your favorite, and so on. You cant miss our game if you want to find some relaxation in your busy life.

title: Safari Story Mahjong
description: Set off on a bright Safari Story Mahjong adventure filled with animals, plants, fruits, and sunny nature tiles! Match free pairs, clear relaxing Mahjong boards, and journey through a colorful saga map packed with cheerful safari moments. Complete levels before time runs out, unlock Gift Box milestones every 8 levels, and collect helpful boosters like Hint, Shuffle, Undo, Torch, and Freeze. A light, rewarding puzzle escape for players who love casual Mahjong fun.

title: Spin Thru
description:
Fit the piece perfectly before the hole arrives!
Tap to rotate! Swipe left or right to flip!
When it’s ready, swipe up to send it through the hole.
Keep succeeding in a row to trigger Fever!
During Fever, easier puzzles will appear for a limited time!

title: Festival Vibes Makeup
description: Join Ellie in Festival Vibes Makeup, a vibrant game radiating the spirit of the summer festivals. Delight in creating neon, boho-Aztec, and grunge makeup looks as you test your makeup artist skills in this colorful makeup game for girls. Mix, match, and shine with stunning eyeshadows, mascaras, lipsticks, and glitter eyebrows!

title: Hexagon
description: Embark on a merging frenzy with "Hexagon"! Place hexagonal tiles on the board, watch them merge and multiply. Create chain reactions and earn points as you strategically fill the hexagonal grid. Can you reach the ultimate merge and trigger the explosive power of 512? Play now and test your merging skills!

title: Italian Brainrot Quiz
description: Italian Brainrot Quiz is a chaotic meme-guessing game where you match bizarre names to iconic brainrot characters! From Tralalero Tralala to Bombardiro Crocodilo and Tung Tung Tung Sahur – can you guess them all? Each round is a wild ride through surreal Italian meme culture. Laugh, confuse your friends, and become the ultimate Brainrot Champion. Spaghetti logic guaranteed. Ready to play?

title: Bubble Shooter Pop
description: Get ready for a nostalgic blast from the past with Bubble Shooter Pop - Blast Fun, the ultimate classic bubble shooter game! Immerse yourself in a world of vibrant bubbles, addictive gameplay, and endless excitement.

title: Marshmallow Rush
description: Marshmallow Rush is a one-button runner where you tap at the right moment to stack fluffy marshmallows, weave through cute obstacles, and dash to the finish. Build the tallest, sweetest tower you can, snag boosters for extra points, and master the timing to clear tricky layouts. Simple to play, satisfying to perfect—how far can your marshmallow tower go?

title: Extreme Real Car Driving 2025
description: This ultimate car racing 3D lets you experience real car driving simulator like highway racing with its realistic car damage, accurate car driving physics and many other features. Car driver may use steering wheel, accelerator meter or buttons to control the car. Enjoy the best car driving simulator game and drag racing game that has an addictive game play with endless fun. Now you can modify your any sports race cars from garage according to your interest.

title: Offroad Climb 4x4
description:
Welcome to "Offroad Climb 4x4", where the hills are alive with the roar of engines! This isn't just a game; it's an off-road odyssey. Imagine climbing up hills, navigating through a scrapyard of cars, scaling rocky terrains, and conquering snow-laden paths.

Whether you're a hardcore off-road enthusiast or just looking for some casual hill-climbing fun, "Offroad Climb 4x4" has something for everyone. So, buckle up, start your engines, and let the off-road adventure begin!

title: Pyramidz2
description: PyramidZ 2 is, as the name suggests, the sequel to PyramidZ. It's a Match-3 game where you have to slide a row or column to align Egyptian symbols. This version is faster and allows for more combos.

title: Shape Transforming: Shifting Run
description: Get ready to dive into the exhilarating world of Shape Transforming: Shifting Run, where the power of transformation is in your hands! This game is a thrilling journey across diverse terrains, challenging players to adapt, transform, and conquer. If you have a knack for quick thinking and love dynamic gameplay, this is the perfect game for you! ??

title: CraftMart
description:
Noob decided to go into business and open his own shop. And what do all the people of Minecraft want? That's right - to eat!

In Noob's shop you can always buy beet soup and bread! And also a lot of other food.

And now all the residents of Minecraft rushed to the best store! Help Noob to serve all the customers! No one should go hungry! :)

Build new fields for wheat and beets, get a cow and a chicken and expand the shop to the maximum assortment!

title: Steal Brainrot Original 3D
description: Buy rare animals—from the entry-level Nubini Pitzanini to Tralalelo Tralal and Los Tralaleritos. Place them in your base, create ideal conditions, and start earning! Each animal generates income ? and opens the door to new opportunities. Grow your collection, improve your infrastructure, experiment with your team composition, and increase your profits. Want more income? Buy new, rarer animals and build your financial empire.

title: Escape Ancient Egypt
description:
a 3D puzzle game in the mysterious ruins of the ancient Egypt, on the footsteps of Cleopatra and the pharaohs.
Can you escape from the pharaoh's curse? Solve the puzzles and unlock the next room, turn on the brain, you'll need it to open all the doors that will allow you to escape.

title: War Of Gun
description: Experience the electrifying world of War Of Gun, an exhilarating first-person multiplayer shooter game. Take your shooting passion to the next level and immerse yourself in thrilling game modes like Raid, Deathmatch, Battle Royale, and Duels. Conquer territories and emerge victorious with stunning graphics and gripping gameplay. Join us now for an unbeatable gaming adventure!

title: Max Crusher 2 - Destruction, Drift, and Racing!
description: Get ready for unbridled automotive chaos in Max Crusher 2 - Destruction, Drift, and Racing!– a game where the three elements of extreme driving merge: devastating crash tests, masterful drifting, and frantic racing!

title: Bus Escape: Clear Jam
description:
Dismantle the bus and send the passengers home in this colorful parking puzzle that delivers both fun and a brain workout. Combining simple gameplay with increasing difficulty, the game is perfect for fans of strategic puzzles and driving simulators.
Get ready for the challenge: sort the cars, find the right solutions, and free up parking spaces. Each car and bus has a limited number of seats, so plan your moves carefully to untangle the chaotic traffic jam.

title: Light Bulb Puzzle
description: Light Bulb Puzzle is a fun and addictive logic-based game where players must turn on all the bulbs using smart moves and strategic thinking. Each bulb is interconnected, meaning one tap can affect multiple lights, creating engaging and challenging gameplay.

title: Leap of Life
description:
"Leap of Life" is a short game that offers a true challenge! Every jump you make is a step towards victory but also a step towards losing a life.
Your task is to preserve each jump, calculating your path precisely to avoid depleting all your lives.

title: BFFs K-Pop Fangirls
description: This exciting game lets you follow the day-to-day life of two real K-pop fangirls. During the day they keep up with their professional lives, but when the clock stickers 6 PM, they gear up in fashionable combat outfits and chase their favorite K-pop idols throughout the city. Get it started, and have a blast mixing and matching different clothing items, hairstyles, and accessories to create the perfect looks for our best friends. Show off your fashion skills by dressing up your favorite girls.

title: Broomcraft Mystic Evasion
description: Broomcraft Mystic Evasion is an action-packed horde survival game where you soar through the skies on a magical broom, battling waves of enemies! Defeat foes and gather experience points to level up and grow stronger. Unlock and master powerful spells, evolving them to take down enemies even faster. Good luck in your battles!

title: 8 Ball Pool Billiards Multiplayer
description: 8 Ball Pool Billiards Multiplayer is a competitive sports pool game that lets you test your skills in exhilarating 2-player matches against friends or go head-to-head with players from around the world. Perfect your game by competing against expert bots to sharpen your strategies and techniques.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Sniper Wars: Find the Criminal
description: The snipers have begun the battle! Find the villain among the crowd of citizens and eliminate him. Take a rifle and go on a dangerous mission to find the criminal! You have a photo of the criminal and a rifle, find him and eliminate him!

title: Spider Solitaire 2 Suits
description: Spider Solitaire 2 Suits is a challenging Solitaire game limited to two suits and two decks of cards. Move the cards around the tableau so they are in order by suit and number.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Number Domination
description: Number Domination is a turn-based strategy card game where players compete to claim tiles on the board using number cards (0-9). Create chains of three or more, match pairs, or make a "Perfect 9" by summing two cards to 9. Each successful move earns points and claims tiles. At the end, each occupied tile grants an extra point to its owner. Play in Face the Challenger or Face the Champion mode and win with smart moves. Think ahead, outplay your opponent, and dominate the numbers!

title: Escape School Duel
description: Escape School Duel is a fast, funny, and tense escape challenge set inside a school that does not want to let you leave. Play solo to chase your best time, or go 2 player and turn every hallway into a race for freedom. One moment you are dodging traps, the next you are trying to slip past the principal in a long corridor or outsmart a teacher waiting near the classroom. Every section has its own danger, so learning the school layout is part of the strategy.

title: Knee Case Simulator
description: Knee Case Simulator is a delightful beauty and doctor simulation game where you get to showcase your medical skills and fashion sense! Help Tiara recover from her knee injury and give her a stylish makeover once she's feeling better.

title: Vehicle Fun Race
description: Vehicle Fun Race—an exhilarating arcade game with 3D stickman characters. Collect motorcycles, cars, boats, and helicopters to reach the finish line. No need to grab vehicles; your character can handle all terrains. Dive into water? No problem—control their swim. Special helicopters await on final platforms. Ready to race? Let’s roll!

title: Mr. Drifter: Car Chase Simulator
description:
Run fast, crash hard, and cheat death — in style.

Race through a chaotic low-poly city as you dodge police, traffic, and total destruction. Use game-changing power-ups like Slow-Mo, Freeze, and EMP Blasts to escape the impossible.

Unlock wild getaway cars
⚡ Grab power-ups mid-chase
 Smash through obstacles & roadblocks
Stylized low-poly world with top-down tilt
Endless cops. Infinite chaos.

One rule: don’t stop. How long can you stay free?

title: Cool Orange Ball: Bounce Adventure
description:
Cool orange ball went on an adventure in which evil stones beat him, but the orange ball has 3 hearts. The game is similar to mario and sonic.

Game Features:
- Lots of exciting levels
- Various biomes
- Secrets in some levels
- Skins of colorful balls

Did you like the game Cool Orange Ball: Bounce Adventure? - Then try our other games and write a review on what to improve or what game we should release next!

title: Celebrities Get Ready For Christmas
description: Step into the world of ‘Celebrities Get Ready for Christmas’! Join your favorite stars as they prepare for the festive season. Explore dazzling holiday outfits, glamorous decorations, and witness the magic of Christmas through the eyes of celebrities. Get ready for a star-studded holiday celebration! Play and have fun!

title: Back 2 School Makeover
description: Embrace the nostalgia and dive into our Back 2 School Makeover game, where you can fashionably express yourself, experiment with stunning looks, and relish into the feeling of heading back to school with style! Embark on a fabulous journey with our character, Amelia, as she transforms from an edgy e-girl to a chic, school-ready fashionista. Revamp her entire look starting with a haircare routine and a new haircut, a complete skincare routine, and a new, school makeup.

title: Archers Random
description:
Archers Random is a fast-paced stickman archery game that tests your reflexes and aim.

Fight endless enemy waves, explore new areas, and earn coins to unlock helmets, armor, and triple arrows. Upgrade speed, damage, health, and arm power, master 12 special arrows like fire, poison, rocket, and electric, face epic bosses, and survive nonstop action.

Play solo or challenge a friend in 2 Player mode on the same device for intense head-to-head battles.

title: FNF 2 Player
description:
FNF 2 Player allows two players to play at the same time. Players can compete with each other by choosing the characters they want. The difficulty level can be determined by the music, thus appealing to all types of players.

Game Modes: 

- Story Mode: You fight with new characters weekly.
- Freeplay Mode: You can play by choosing the song you want.
- 2 Player Mode: It's time to duel with your friend.

title: Festival Vibes Makeup
description: Festival Vibes Makeup is a beauty game where you step into the world of Coachella-inspired looks. Let your inner artist shine as you craft neon, boho-Aztec, and grunge styles.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Neon Blast
description: Upgrade your defense cannons by merging them!Watch as your cannons level up and become powerful defenders, and get exciting new powers to crush bosses and attackers!

title: Digital Aqua
description:
Digital Aqua is a digital aquarium designed for PC Browser.
Explore the vibrant world of aquariums, where colorful tropical fish and stunning underwater landscapes come to life.
Transform your Monitor into a serene and enchanting aquarium that fills your living room with comfort and wonder.

title: Bubble Shooter Temple Jewels
description: Embark on a temple adventure in Bubble Shooter Temple Jewels! Pop colorful bubbles as you progress through ancient ruins inspired by Central American temples. Keep track of your journey with the Stats screen, showing your best, current, and previous scores across Novice, Expert, and Master modes. With vibrant visuals, exciting challenges, and detailed progress tracking, this bubble shooter keeps you motivated to aim higher and improve every round!

title: Upside Down
description:
Upside Down is a puzzle platformer game in which you must control the character, gather all of the stars and keys, and complete all of the levels.

The levels are difficult and mental exercises. In order to finish the levels, you have to switch between two distinct worlds. The lovely graphics and calming soundtrack make the game enjoyable and lovely. Go through the portal, leap, run, get away, and enjoy yourself.

title: Island Expander
description:
Island Expander — relaxing crafting game. Collect resources, discover 30+ recipes, and grow your island step by step!
It is a cozy crafting game where you transform a tiny island into a paradise.
Collect resources, unlock recipes, craft items — from simple tools to complex machines — and watch your island grow with every step.

Start building your dream island today! ?

title: Escape Again
description: Together with the main character of the new online game Escape Again, you will go on a journey through the painted world in search of treasures and adventures. The location in which your hero will be will be visible on the screen in front of you. By controlling his actions you will have to move around the area. Overcoming various obstacles and traps, you will have to help the hero find special magic pins. With their help, he will be able to activate the portal leading to the next level.

title: WorldGuessr
description: In Worldguessr, each game starts by placing you somewhere on Google Maps, and if you can’t immediately guess where you are, which is likely the majority of the time as you often start on obscure, long, and winding roads, you can move around to gather valuable clues. description:
Swing between platforms in Arcade Rope! Play free and online in this rope-swinging adventure.
Arcade Rope is a fast-paced and addictive skill game where your goal is to swing from platform to platform using a rope. Perfectly time your swings to avoid falling into the abyss and see how far you can go. The gameplay is simple yet challenging, making it ideal for quick play sessions. Stay alert, react quickly, and master the art of swinging to survive longer.

title: Mickey Run Adventure Game
description:
Welcome to the great kingdom craft! prepare yourself brave mickey, get ready to run, jump, dash and rush through the kingdom.
In this craft game, you will be a runner who has to run and collect coins in an endless runner game mine. You need to be very careful as there will be many mouse in your way. You will need to use your craft Mickey and reflexes to avoid them and keep running. There will also be power-ups that you can collect to help you in the craft game.

title: Labo Brick Train Game For Kids
description: This is an assembly train game for all ages. Do you like small train toys? Have you ever wanted to assemble a beloved train by yourself? You can't miss our game if you are interested in all this.First of all, you need to pick out your favorite train style. Then start assembling the train from the locomotive, followed by the body.

title: Merge Racer Stunts Car
description:
Welcome to Merge Racer - Stunts Car! This is an exciting and creative racing game. You show your driving skills and use the power of merge to build supercars! Merge the same types of cars to create stronger racing machines. Each merge improves your car’s performance, helping
you speed ahead of your rivals.

title: Cargo Path Puzzle
description: Cargo Path Puzzle is a challenging 3D puzzle game that tests both logic and movement strategy. Navigate through complex levels filled with collapsing platforms, ice slides, trampolines, directional blocks, and deadly voids. Every level has only one correct path, so you'll need to think ahead and plan each move wisely. A single wrong step could trap you or block the way forward.

title: Sprunki Find The Differences
description:
Unleash Your Detective Skills with Sprunki Find The Differences!
Inspired by the charming world of Sprunki, this game takes your observation skills to the next level. Dive into beautifully crafted scenes filled with vibrant details, where your task is to spot the differences between two seemingly identical images.
Whether you're a fan of Sprunki or just love a good brain teaser, Sprunki Find The Differences offers a perfect mix of challenge and fun for players of all ages

title: Badlands Hero
description:
Step into a treacherous world teeming with enemies and peril. Guide your hero across the battlefield — they’ll fire automatically when foes show up!

? Conquer intense levels
? Gain XP to unlock unique heroes
? Gather gold to enhance your gear
? Unleash powerful weapon types
? Face off against epic bosses and climb the ranks

Easy to play, hard to master. Do you have what it takes to rule the Badlands?

title: Paris Kiss
description: Welcome to Paris Kiss, a fun and quirky puzzle game where your goal is simple — bring the characters together for a kiss

title: CubeRealm.io
description: CubeRealm.io is a captivating online block game inspired by classics like Minecraft and Terraria. In this immersive world, you’ll gather resources, craft tools, and explore diverse biomes from skylands to deep underground caverns.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Color Screw Rescue Puzzle
description: Color Screw Rescue Puzzle challenges your brain with colorful screws, tricky layouts, and exciting rescue missions. Every level combines strategic thinking with satisfying screw-removal mechanics, creating a unique experience that fans of casual games and color sort games won't want to miss.

title: Shark Chomp Chase
description: Play Shark Chomp Chase free online and jump into a fast-paced browser game you can play instantly with no download and no install. This unblocked game loads fast and runs smoothly at school or home, making it perfect for quick breaks. Hunt, grow, and survive as you master each chase in a fun, skill-based challenge that feels like a light brain game. Mobile-friendly and built for desktop and mobile, it’s a free online game that’s easy to start and hard to put down.

title: Farm Triple Match
description:
Looking for a fun tile-matching puzzle game? Try Farm Triple Match, a fresh take on tile-matching for puzzle lovers! This mahjong-inspired game is easy to learn but offers exciting challenges.
Beat levels and build your own farm with cute animals and a lovely garden.
Classic gameplay with a modern twist for relaxing brain training.
Explore a variety of tiles featuring fruits, veggies, animals, and more.
Use boosters to conquer tough puzzles and keep progressing. No time limits—play anytime!

title: Fish rain 2
description:
"Cast and pull!" is the motto of this fishing game. Everything is real here: the sounds in the locations, and the online chat. Share your legendary trophies with other players, show off your catch, and name the weight and type of fish.

 Try to catch a pike or a catfish, a perch or a minnow, or maybe a carp or a sturgeon?

 Fish in different locations: on a rocky shore or on the Pripyat River. Use a variety of baits, from worms to live bait and leeches.

title: Diamondz
description: DiamondZ is a special variant of Match-3. Here, the goal is not to directly manipulate jewels on the board but to insert them on the left or right side to eliminate groups and make diamonds fall into the mine carts. Help the little miner collect as much wealth as possible!

title: Run 3D
description: The infinite running platformer game Run 3D takes place in the immensity of space. The character must be navigated by players through the constantly shifting space. Go, leap, and keep yourself from plummeting into the chasm!

title: Slicer Duo
description: Slicer Duo is a satisfying ASMR game where precision, timing, and rhythm come together in a sharp slicing adventure. Move through level-based stages, cut through fruits and all kinds of objects, collect points, and try to keep your knife in motion for as long as possible. While the controls are simple, every section demands focus because one bad move can send your knife straight into danger.

title: Best Friends Puzzle
description: Hop on an epic adventure with the Bug Heroes and help them defeat the menacing birds of the forest! Strategically link at least three symbols of the same colour to empower the Heroes with their special perks. Explore the lush green forests with your bug friends.

title: Ninja Spell Match
description: Ninja Spell Match is a fast-paced blend of match-3 puzzling and ninja action. Connect tiles to charge up your attacks and unleash devastating moves against waves of enemies. With each level, the challenge grows tougher as you fight your way through 30 unique stages packed with traps, puzzles, and rival ninjas. Think fast, match smart, and strike hard—your reflexes and strategy are the only way to survive.

title: Plants Vs Zombies War
description: Plants Vs Zombies War is based on the famous PC game called Plants VS Zombies. This tower-defense strategy game needs your plans to fight against 15 kinds of incoming zombies. You can check the consumption and attack of all of your 15 plants before the battle. Then the tutorial will show the basic rules and plants at Level 1. The more levels you complete, the more plants you can unlock. You could also unlock them from ads in advance.

title: Fairy Wingerella
description: Soar through the skies with Fairy Wingerella in this action-packed arcade adventure! Meet Wingerella, a fearless and ambitious fairy striving to become the most powerful of her kind. Embark on her magical journey, navigating enchanting skies and conquering exciting challenges. With captivating visuals and engaging gameplay, this adventure promises endless fun and excitement!

title: My Perfect Farm
description:
Begin with a tiny patch of arable land and build a full farm tycoon. What was tiny becomes something powerful through smart decisions and careful resource management.
This interesting farming simulator game allows you to have fun while planting seeds, raising animals by feeding them, and enjoying a full harvest like a true farm owner.
This farming game lets you unlock new areas and earn rewards with every upgrade.

title: Murder Stone Age
description: Test your instincts in Murder Stone Age, a suspenseful tap-based thriller. Watch your back as mysterious figures follow you. One of them may mean harm. Tap to glance behind just in time: guess wrong and it's over. Can you outwit the stalker and survive?

title: Jet Fighter Airplane Racing
description:
Are you a fan of car traffic games & street racing? Do you like planes and the sky? We have something new to play! Try a plane flying game with different missions, improve your flying skills and become a true professional in racing piloting in Jet Fighter Airplane Racing!

Are you looking for exclusive aeroplanes?
• MiG-21 “Fishbed"
• McDonnell Douglas F-4 Phantom II
• MiG-29 “Fulcrum”
• F-16 Fighting Falcon
• MiG-31 BM “Foxhound”
• F-22 Raptor
• SU-35 “Flanker-E”
• SU-47 "Firkin"
• SU-57

title: Ragdoll Mega Dunk
description:
Welcome to the Ragdoll Mega Dunk indoor extreme basketball club! The game is a cool Ragdoll style basketball simulator .
Every attempt to do a trick will be unique! Throw the ball into the basket and fly there yourself!

title: Cosmic Tetriz Puzzles
description: Join a cosmic puzzle adventure where Tetriz meets pixel art. Place colorful Tetriz-style pieces on a grid to create shapes, ranging from easy to complex. Each piece has its own spot, adding to the challenge. Complete 45 levels, solving cosmic Tetriz puzzles in a space-themed setting. Can you beat this cosmic challenge before time's up?

title: Divinex
description:
Embark on a captivating journey into the world of Divinex! Solve challenging puzzles by matching pairs of themed tiles adorned with intricate symbols! Сhallenge yourself with increasingly difficult levels, create a unique atmosphere by choosing new avatars and backgrounds. Immerse yourself in the magical world of Divinex - a new relaxing game with stunning visuals - explore all levels and uncover the magic hidden within the tiles!
Begin your journey today with Divinex!

title: Cryptoword
description: Cryptoword is a word game that takes you on an epic journey through enchanted realms. Tackle challenging puzzles, face formidable foes, and discover hidden treasures.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: BLOCK MATCH 8x8
description:
Place blocks to form vertical or horizontal rows and erase the target blocks!
The game is over when no more blocks can be placed or there are no moves left.

title: Drill Quest
description:
Drill Quest is a casual game combining the excitement of crushing blocks, upgrading your drill, and building your city. 

Explore diverse locations, progressively upgrade your equipment, and choose from machines.

title: Ultra Realistic BlockCraft
description: Help Steve in the ultra-realistic block world and make sure he reaches the portal. Remember, this realistic world is extremely challenging and monsters are roaming everywhere. You must collect all the diamonds. While collecting diamonds, don’t forget to open the chests you find along the way. Open the chests and crush all the monsters. Reach the portal at the end of the level safely to complete the stage. Remember, you only have one life and if it runs out you will lose everything you’ve earned.

title: Merge the Coins USSR!
description: ● Game in an unusual setting! Compete with friends and colleagues?! In the game you have a playing area? where coins fall and are connected if they are the same! Connect as many coins as possible to make the biggest one, save up points?! Be the first on the leaderboard?! Play and relax ?!

title: Spring Magic Enchanted Wardrobe
description: Immerse yourself in the magical world of the game, where two amazing heroines are waiting for you - a centaur princess and a fairy princess, each of whom has her own special fashion style. Create unique looks for them by choosing from a variety of makeup options, hairstyles, accessories and a variety of spring outfits inspired by nature itself. Live out your fantasies and create your own fairy tale in the world of fashion and magic!

title: Magic Bubbles
description: Quick games, satisfying pops and constant rewards — what’s not to love? Enjoy a bubble shooter built for endless play, with weekly bonuses, boosters that change the game and the Lucky Wheel for a little extra fun. There’s always something new to pop.

title: Nuwpy's Adventure
description:
Nuwpy’s Adventure is a classic pixel-art platformer inspired by retro arcade games!
Help Nuwpy explore colorful worlds, collect coins, jump over enemies, and avoid traps.
Each level offers new challenges, hidden secrets, and a fast-paced journey full of charm and nostalgia.
Dive into the pixel world and enjoy simple yet addictive gameplay!

title: Bubble Match Merge
description: A colorful bubble merge puzzle game where you pull bubbles, connect matching items, and complete level goals within a limited number of moves.

title: Block Craft 3D School
description: Welcome to Block Craft 3D-School. Here creativity meets adventure! In this pixel-style game, you will enter a world of endless possibilities, like Minecraft. To build and protect your school using blocks of various shapes! But be careful that this isn't just a building game! Enemies hide anywhere and are ready to hit you! Besides, collect and place blocks.

title: Fruit Mahjong 3D
description: Fruit Mahjong 3D is a relaxing puzzle game where you match pairs of fruit-themed tiles in 3D space. Rotate the view, find free tiles, and clear the board by matching identical pieces. Each level is handcrafted and fully solvable, offering a mix of easy and challenging layouts. The game starts with a short tutorial and gradually increases in difficulty. Use shuffle and hint buttons if you get stuck. Enjoy colorful graphics, smooth animations, and intuitive controls on both mobile and desktop.

title: OpenGuessr - Geo Guessing
description: OpenGuessr is a free trivia quiz geography game that drops you into a street-level panorama anywhere on Earth and challenges you to figure out where you are. Identify the continent, narrow it down to the country, zero in on the city, and pinpoint the exact street.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Duet Cats Halloween Cat Music
description: Welcome to Duet Cats Halloween Cat Music, a game feast for 2 players filled with fun and music!Join your friends in this Halloween-inspired game to challenge the cat's music and have fun! With the rhythm of the music, control the cute cat to move. Let them eat more ice cream. You can choose a different musical challenge. You should accurately move to collect ice cream, and get the highest high score!

title: Spider Rope Hero City Fight
description: Protect the crime city by your extreme super powers. You will be a rope hero with ability of flying, crawling and spider. Now you have to eliminate the mafia. Your duty starts with the ultimate security of the president. The gangsters have kidnapped the state president, chased the gangsters and saved your president. Swing into action and unleash your superhero powers to save the city from chaos and destruction.

title: Mini Games Puzzle Collection
description:
Mini Games: Puzzle Collection is an addictive collection of mini games, including 3 of the most popular puzzle games. You need to use limited wooden planks to build a bridge to help doge eat
bones on the other side of the river, draw lines to send donuts to doge. You can also experience the day of a stall owner, satisfying the needs of customers exactly. These fresh and interesting challenges require you to use your brain and solve them one by one through logical thinking.

title: Duo Family Santa
description: Steve and Alex need to race against each other. The one who holds the Lucky Block wins the game. Hold onto the Lucky Block until the time runs out to win the game. You can earn money by collecting socks and you can also earn money by defeating your friend. You must be very careful; steal the Lucky Block from your friend and keep it until the time is up.

title: Color Maze
description: In Color Maze your mission is to light up all the paths on the map to complete a level. Make the right move, avoiding obstacles or just pay attention to not get stuck in a corner. Beat all the 20 levels with increasing difficulty to show yourself that you are the real king of Color Maze.  Remember, if a level is to hard for you, you can always skip it clicking or touching the reward button in the up right corner of the screen.

title: Ice fishing 3d
description:
❄ Fishing is a great kind of recreation and an opportunity to spend time with excitement! If you are a real fisherman at heart and are ready to test your skills, then this ice fishing game is just for you.

? Wherever you are in winter or summer - you can always find yourself on snow-covered ice among beautiful winter landscapes. Drill, rod, bait and a lake that always bites, what else does a born fisherman need?

title: Mr Long Legs
description: Get ready to wobble, stretch, and stumble with Mr. Long Legs, the funniest physics puzzle game you’ll ever play! Step into the shoes of a long-legged stickman hero and control his stretchy legs to cross impossible terrains.

title: Bombardino Crocodilo terror jumpscare
description: Welcome to Bombardino Crocodilo: Terror Jumpscare, a spine-chilling horror game that will test your nerves, reflexes, and courage. In this twisted nightmare, you take on the role of an unfortunate visitor trapped inside a cursed, abandoned mansion. Your mission? Collect all the creepy dolls scattered across the dark, decrepit corridors and escape before its too late. Sounds simple? Think again.

title: Summer Triple Mahjong
description: Enjoy a relaxing summer puzzle adventure in Summer Triple Mahjong!Match and collect 3 identical tiles that are free on the left or right side. Clear all the tiles before time runs out to complete the level and unlock new challenges. If you get stuck, use the Hint feature to help you find matches. If the time runs out, you can watch a reward ad to pause the timer and keep playing.

title: SuperPixelint
description:
It's a game where you draw a cute little image.
You can develop color matching skills and accuracy without any burden.
Why don't you get out of your daily life for a while and heal yourself through coloring games?

title: Foot Hospital
description: HELP! Doctor, I hurt my feet, ouch! It is so painful!Could you please help me to cure my feet? I know you have the best medical tools here!

title: Dots Master
description:
Dots Master is a fun and strategic puzzle game where you connect matching dots to solve colorful challenges. Connect dots vertically or horizontally, and form squares to clear all dots of the same color in a single move!

Each level has a special goal — clear a certain number of colored dots, pop stars, make loops, or conquer the tiles — all within a limited number of moves. With 5 exciting chapters packed with creative puzzles.

title: Secrets of Charmland
description: Charmland is a delightful adventure game where you join Emma and her friend Marshmellado in feeding adorable animals their favorite foods. Travel through enchanting lands filled with tasty treats as you help make the magical creatures of Charmland happy.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Daring Jack
description:
Jack, an adventurer, was flying over the sea in his small aircraft. When he reached a jungle island, his aircraft's engine failed and he lost control. He escaped from the crashing aircraft, landed safely on the island, and now must find a boat to leave.

He knows of the old boathouse on the island but is uncertain how to reach it. Guide him through the jungle to the boathouse. Help him gather items for survival, focusing on securing food and shelter while navigating the challenging terrain.

title: TileMan.io
description: TileMan.io is an awesome multiplayer IO game in which you must try to claim as much territory as possible. You start with a random block color, and you must try to convert all the blocks on the map into the same color.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Sniper Master
description: Take aim in mid-air and strike at the perfect moment! In Sniper Master, you jump, float, and fire while airborne—time your shots to eliminate targets with clean, satisfying hits. Stay calm, lead your aim, and master precision shooting across multiple levels. Earn rewards, improve your skills, and become the ultimate airborne marksman.

title: Daily Jewels Blitz Mahjong
description: Enjoy Daily Mahjong with a sparkling jewels twist! Play a unique layout every day, match dazzling gem tiles, and keep your streak alive to earn boosters like Hint, Shuffle, Undo, and Torch. Track your longest streak and collect daily rewards as you match your way through beautiful designs. Miss a day? There’s a rare chance to recover it. Relax, match, and dive into the timeless charm of Daily Mahjong with a brilliant jewels theme!

title: Art Puzzle Master
description:
Welcome to Art Puzzle Master, a fun and challenging puzzle game that will test your logic and problem-solving skills! 

In this game, you'll be presented with a series of beautiful artworks that have been divided into small, jumbled pieces. Your task is to rearrange the pieces and form the complete image, but be careful – the puzzles get more difficult as you progress through the levels!

title: Lucky Brainrot Blocks Online
description: Lucky Brainrot Blocks Online game takes the familiar lucky box idea and turns it into a more active risk-and-return loop. You move through 14 areas, open boxes, collect brainrots, and decide whether to head back safely or keep pushing for rarer finds. Online play is available through 1 Player mode, while local 2-player adds a same-screen option for faster, more chaotic sessions. Rebirth, speed upgrades, better boxes, base expansion, and roaming bosses keep every run moving forward.

title: Seafaring Memory Challenge
description: Set sail into the captivating depths of the ocean with Seafaring Memory Challenge! Match pairs of sea-themed icons in an endless array of levels. Test your memory skills as you uncover treasures like colorful fish, delicate sea shells, and sunken treasures. With no level limit, the adventure never ends, providing hours of entertainment. Stay sharp and immerse yourself in the mesmerizing world beneath the waves!

title: ChickZ Stack
description:
ChickZ Stack is a fun and addictive arcade game where flying chickens take to the sky! stack your chickens to overcome obstacles and glide through colorful, challenging levels.

The taller your chicken stack, the easier it is to pass walls, traps, and enemies.

Unlock adorable flying chickens, explore new worlds, and compete for high scores.

With simple one-tap controls and fast-paced gameplay, ChickZ Stack is easy to play but hard to master.

Stack, fly, and flap your way to victory!

title: Color Block Blast 3
description:
Drag and drop the correct block into the grid. Match 3 or more tiles of the same colour to eliminate them.

Score beautiful combos while earning bonus points and watching beautiful animations take shape.

How high can you score in this endless match 3 game?

title: Looper
description:
Looper is a joyous and melodious music game that tests your sense of rhythm and timing. Get ready to start tapping your way through a colorful universe of beats and melodies! With hundreds of unique levels, Looper is the perfect game to soothe your puzzling needs.

As you progress, the constellations become more complex, and the beats more satisfying. But be warned, mistiming a tap could lead to an epic crash and burn - so make sure to bring your A-game!

title: Hexa Tile Master
description: Welcome to Hexa Tile Master! Drag stacks of hex tiles from the bottom of your screen to empty spots on the board. Watch as similar tiles merge into bigger stacks, and collect stacks of 10 or more matching tiles to clear them. Your goal is to clear all the hex tiles before time runs out. Each level gets more challenging, but don't worry—fun animations and exciting rewards will keep you engaged. Enjoy the strategic fun and see how far you can go!

title: Among Squid Challenge Online
description: All players, get ready. They are hiding in a maze. To win the game, you must defeat all the other players. You have a knife and must defeat everyone. Catch the players one by one and make sure they are eliminated. Don’t worry, they won’t find you. If they try to find you, hide in the ventilation holes. Defeat all the players. Be careful, and whatever you do, don't reveal yourself. If they catch you, you will lose and they will defeat you.

title: Ships 3D IO
description: Ships 3D is an IO game, multiplayer sailing ship simulator. The game is played in 'first person' where you control the sailor and move around the ship; interacting with the helm, sails and cannons. Sink enemy ships and shoot other players to score points.

title: Royal Garden Match
description: Welcome to Royal Garden Match! You’ve inherited a grand Royal Castle and a once-beautiful garden—now it’s up to you to bring its beauty to life! Solve exciting match-3 puzzles by combining exquisite royal flowers, fruits, and plants to unlock powerful boosters. With hundreds of challenging levels, unique royal characters, and a magical journey ahead, there's always something new to discover. Can you make the royal garden flourish? Play now and start your enchanting adventure!

title: Bublix: Bubble Hit
description: Bublix: Bubble Hit is a fast-paced bubble shooter where precision and strategy matter. Aim, shoot, and match 3 or more bubbles to clear the board. Use clever angles, wall bounces, and combos to boost your score. With endless gameplay and rising difficulty, it’s perfect for quick, addictive sessions.

title: Grand Clash Arena
description:
Grand Clash Arena is a unique war game that offers an action-packed experience.

Key Features of the Game:

-Epic Combat Experience: Showcase your mastery against opponents by using every object at your disposal.

-Drop Weapons and Surprises: Alter the flow of the game with surprise drops from the sky. Surprise your opponents with powerful weapons that suddenly appear and gain an advantage.

Grand Clash Arena offers a unique gaming experience that combines the art of war and strategy.

title: Playground- Parkour
description: Jump and break bones, destroy enemies and unlock new levels! Ragdoll physics is what you need for parkour lovers. Train, participate in the battle and upgrade your hero! You will enjoy the game if you are a lover of the playground and stick games. Run, jump and maim the heroes. Ragdoll-style physics is what you love. Deals damage and unlock new levels! Stick and Ragdoll fans will be happy.

title: Kingdom Wars TD
description: Welcome to Kingdom Wars TD, an exciting tower-defense strategy game set in a captivating 2D kingdom. Assume the role of a skilled commander entrusted with the defense of a mighty castle. In your quest, assemble a formidable army comprising up to five soldiers, including archers, warriors, and priests. Brace yourself for the challenge of surviving two perilous waves across various meticulously designed levels scattered throughout the map. Immerse yourself in this thrilling adventure!

title: Solitaire Tail
description: Raise your dragons at Solitaire! Clear the game by moving all cards to the foundation! Move cards from the tableau or stockpile in ascending order of the same suit. In the tableau, you can stack cards in descending order with alternating colors! You can place a King card in an empty column! When there are no available moves, you can draw cards from the stockpile to the foundation or tableau!

title: Sudoku - Pin.Games
description:
Sudoku - PIN.GAMES is a polished, feature-rich take on the timeless number puzzle. Fill the 9×9 grid so that every row, column, and 3×3 block contains the digits 1–9 exactly once.

With six difficulty levels, smart hints, combo scoring, daily challenges, and five handcrafted visual themes, it offers a clean, relaxing, and logic-focused Sudoku experience for both casual players and puzzle lovers.

title: Card Quest: 10 Minute Adventure
description: Embark on an exhilarating journey with Card Quest: 10 Minute Adventure, where quick thinking and strategy collide in an exciting online card challenge. Build your deck, make smart moves, and face thrilling encounters that test your skills and timing. Designed for both desktop and mobile players, this free-to-play adventure delivers fast, tactical gameplay and endless replayability. Every decision shapes your path — can you conquer the quest in just ten minutes?

title: Tsunami Brainrots Online
description: Tsunami Brainrots Online is a fast-paced survival experience inspired by meme culture and chaotic movement gameplay. Players must escape a massive tsunami wave while exploring dangerous areas, collecting valuable brainrot characters, and returning safely before time runs out. The game offers an online single-player mode where you can interact with others through chat, as well as a local 2 player option for shared-screen action.

title: Obby On a Bike
description: Obby On a Bike, a thrilling bike-riding platformer that combines exciting obstacle courses with fun parkour gameplay! It features two exciting gameplay modes: Normal and Challenge. In Normal mode, you can carefully ride through each level without the stress of a timer. Challenge mode lets you test your speed and skill as you race against time. Whether you're playing alone or competing head-to-head in the 2 Player mode, there's always a thrilling challenge awaiting you!

title: Pixel Shoot
description: Pixel Shoot is a fast-paced arcade puzzle game. It's simple to play by just tapping the cannons. Make sure you pay attention to the color and base your strategy around it. You must also manage your capacity, and timing is key! Send your cannons in the right order, manage the flow, and maximize your score.

title: Brainrot Clicker
description:
Brainrot Clicker is a hilarious and chaotic idle clicker game that plunges you into a bizarre world of meme-fueled madness. Your mission is simple: tap the screen to earn “Italian Brainrot Points” and unlock increasingly ridiculous AI-generated characters from the internet’s wildest corners.

With eye-catching visuals, meme-inspired humor, and endless upgrades, Brainrot Clicker offers a weirdly satisfying experience you won’t want to stop!

title: Devil Dash
description: Level Devil Dash is ready to break the ultimate limit within your inner demon rage! Prepare for a hellish journey that demands top-notch improvisation skills and extreme patience. You will embark on an adventure through interconnected worlds, tightly linked to one another.

title: Disassemble the picture: Puzzle!
description:
Unlock your brain power and dive into the world of puzzles!
Start playing "Disassemble the picture: Puzzle!" right now!

In this fun and addictive game, your goal is to move the blocks to clear the screen and reveal the hidden image.
But here’s the twist — the blocks can only move in specific directions, so you’ll need to think carefully and plan your moves strategically.

title: My Fire Station World
description: Have you ever wondered how the firefighter rescues and helps others in emergencies? How do they deal with dangerous fires? This role-play takes you to explore the world of firefighters and learn about their daily work. Our game has 6 scenarios about the life and work of firefighters for you to choose from. You can drag and drop to place the characters as you like, place props, and change the firefighting costumes.

title: Angry City Smasher
description: Angry City Smasher is a third-person RPG fighting simulation game with 3D-armed gorillas. Your goal is to defeat the enemy monster and destroy the marked number of buildings. Use the Ultimate Smash to make AOE damage and destroy more buildings with one hit. To be honest, it is necessary to defeat your opponent first because it will run to you on the level. No one wants to be disturbed by others. Good luck!

title: Tricky Challenges: Mini Games
description:
Only 5% will pass all the Challenges! Ready to test your reactions and wit? Take the challenge and prove that you are better than thousands of bloggers!

✨ "Tricky Challenges: Mini Games" is a unique game that combines popular challenges from TipTop and puzzle elements.

title: Lazy Workers
description: The employees in the office have started slacking off and everyone is asleep. As the boss, you need to get the office back up and running. To do this, use your mouse and send employees to rows of desks. Move workers so they do not bump into each other. Your job will get a little more difficult with each level. If you cannot pass the level, you can use the option to skip the level.

title: Lucy All Season Fashioninsta
description: "Lucy All Season Fashionista" invites you to four seasonal clothing adventures! From spring to winter, create combinations that cover every season. Experience the freedom to create your own style by complementing Lucy's fashion with accessories. This fun and heartfelt game is ideal for anyone who is interested in fashion!

title: Dream Restaurant 3D
description: Ready for the ultimate restaurant challenge in Dream Restaurant 3D? Embark on a journey to establish your very own restaurant empire. The mission is straightforward: swiftly attend to customers, prepare delectable hamburgers, stack them up, and gracefully serve them around the tables. Expand your team by hiring proficient waiters, accumulate profits, and gradually construct an unparalleled restaurant empire!

title: CraftsMan 3D Gangster
description:
In the new action game CraftsMan 3D Gangster, which is exciting and similar to Minecraft, you may become a real-life gangster roaming the streets of the city. As you explore the open world, you'll encounter other criminals who are eager to wipe you off the map.

Get through every level of this fun 3D action game, where you'll face more frightening adversaries.

title: Idle Trade Routes
description: Command a growing fleet of merchant ships across a shimmering ocean in Idle Trade Routes. Link bustling islands, auto‑dock at busy ports, and optimize trade lines to keep goods flowing. Unlock new ships, hire captains, and chase bigger contracts as your profits grow even while you’re away.

title: Boom Stick Bazooka
description:
In Boom Stick Bazooka, an explosive online game where you may customize your bazooka and smash platforms and opposing stickmen, you're in for a wild ride. The black stickmen are stationed in towers, and if you pause for even a second, they'll open fire, attempting to wipe off your three lives.

In each level, you'll have three chances to aim and fire; you may always try again or purchase more ammo. If you want to kill foes quickly, blow up the barrels so they explode and knock down the towers.

title: Block Blast 2048
description: Block Blast 2048 is a fun and addictive puzzle game where you merge blocks with the same number to create higher values. Keep merging to boost your score and face increasing challenges. How far can you go? Can you reach the ultimate block? Play now and test your puzzle skills!

title: Pet Connect Match
description: Pet Connect Match is an interesting matching game, in this game, you need to connect the same pets to eliminate all of them.  There are many different modes you can choose, you can pass levels, challenge time mode or just play without any limit. Have a good time!

title: JailBreak : Escape from Prison
description: Experience the thrill of jailbreak escape, find a way out to freedom in our adventure filled jailbreak games! In this exciting jailbreak escape journey, you’ll take on the role of a character trapped behind jail bars, where every level presents unique challenges and exciting mini games, leading to the final goal of prison escape. Your goal in this prison games? Outsmart the system, solve clever puzzles, and find a way out in this immersive jailbreak escape adventure.

title: Blackriver Mystery. Hidden Objects
description: "Blackriver: Search for objects" is a new game in which you have to try on the role of a mystical detective, the one who is destined to restore the town from the ruins and solve its mystery. Here you will find a lot of interesting quests, unique collections, popular mini-games (such as three-in-a-row, wheel of fortune and others).

title: Tarcat
description:
Enter the world of feline destruction with Tarcat, a hilarious casual game where you control a cats paw! Your goal? Smash all targets with quick reflexes and pinpoint accuracy!

With just one tap, hit targets, avoid traps, and dominate each level with the style of a true feline destroyer.

title: Dear Island
description:
Collect two blocks that match the color of the Match Slot to clear them!
Clear them all to finish the stage!
Blocks of different colors can be placed in the Stock.
If the Stock gets full, it’s game over!

title: Stickman Guys Defense
description:
Stickman Guys Defense is an action-packed tower defense game where you must protect your base from endless waves of enemies! Command a team of brave stickman warriors, place them strategically, and upgrade their abilities to stop the invasion. From archers to sword fighters, build the ultimate defense and survive each level!

Can you defend your land and become the ultimate Stickman commander?

title: Cyber Highway Escape
description: Experience the thrill of high-speed cyberpunk bike racing under the neon lights of a futuristic metropolis, as you weave your way through the winding streets and dodge obstacles in this adrenaline-fueled nocturnal adventure.

title: Football Heads 2025
description: Unlock your potential and prove your skills. Outplay your opponents using powerful kicks and unique power-ups. Finally let them know who is the boss with the emotes system - become a football legend today!

title: Prásino
description: Prasino is a free-to-play forest adventure game that combines exploration, survival, and environmental restoration. As nature’s last hope, your mission is to travel through beautiful landscapes, collect magical seeds, and revive the forest by planting trees. Along the way, you must watch out for dangerous enemies and manage your breath carefully to keep exploring deeper into the wild.

title: Sid & Ginny Y2K Glam Clash
description: Welcome to the Y2K style fashion world! Two charismatic heroines are waiting for you, ready to try on fashion trends from the 2000s. Create spectacular makeup for them with lip gloss, shining shadows and glossy skin; choose stylish hairstyles - from smooth straight hair to playful ponytails and fashionable hairpins. Experiment with low-cut jeans, crop tops, mini skirts, shiny fabrics, and bold combinations. Complete the resulting image with iconic accessories of those years.

title: Egg Adventure
description: You need to manipulate eggs to solve all kinds of puzzles and get out of the door, seemingly simple but hidden secrets.The key to solving the problem may be a word or an action, which means that you need to understand it carefully

title: Snow Rush 3D
description:
Snow Rush 3D is a fun sledding game that tests speed and reflexes for winter sports enthusiasts, playable in both 1 and 2 players! Try to reach the longest distance by overcoming obstacles and ramps on a challenging snow-covered track, or challenge your friend!

Snowmen, obstacles and tricky turns await you along the way. How far can you go and how many gifts can you collect?

title: Hospital Inc
description: Step into the fast-paced world of Hospital Inc, an exciting management simulator. This addictive idle tycoon casual game lets you build, expand, and manage your own hospital while earning profits even when you're away.

title: Bolts and Nuts - Puzzle
description:
An educational and exciting game in which you can test your logical and strategic thinking.
Solve unique puzzles to while away the time and relax with excellent soundtrack. A bright and exciting game is perfect not only for children, but will also give you the opportunity to test your skills in solving difficult problems for adults.

title: Gross Out Run
description: Gross Out Run is a parkour game. Compete against two other AI runners and the first player to reach the finish line wins! Be careful, you have to avoid the sledgehammers on the road, which will block your progress and stain your clothes simultaneously. It's time to make a change! Can you get to the finish line first and keep yourself tidy?

title: Hot & Cold Winter Style
description: Princesses Eliza and Milana are going on winter vacation, but for each of the girls, winter vacation will be special. Eliza lives in snowy regions and loves fluffy fur coats, warm scarves and winter dresses. Milana celebrates her holidays under palm trees and chooses swimsuits, light capes and bright accessories. Players will have to create stylish images, combining the cold shine of snow and the warm glow of the tropics. Help Eliza and Milana become the most fashionable princesses of winter!

title: Heroes of the Arena
description: Heroes of the Arena is an RPG game where you create your own hero and forge a path through battles and adventure. You’ll team up with allies, face powerful enemies, and shape your journey by enhancing skills, unlocking pets, and joining epic clan wars.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Worm: Apple Quest
description:
Get Ready for Challenging Puzzles in Worm: Apple Quest!

In this captivating puzzle platformer, guide your worm to the legendary Golden Apple while navigating devious obstacles and perilous chasms. The secret to success? Mastering your worm's growing length.

Every apple you collect makes your worm longer, unlocking new paths - but beware! With greater length comes tougher control. One wrong turn and you might get stuck, ending your run.

title: Bouncing Chick
description: In Bouncing Chick you have to reach your nest as fast as you can, avoiding obstacles and hazards. Go to the top of the level and try to beat your record! There are 24 levels to beat, so what are you waiting for? Start your climbing to the top!

title: Mobile Phone Case Diy
description: This is a mobile phone case game that was designed. Have you ever wanted to create a fashion phone case of your own? In the game, you can show your creativity, enjoy the art of customisation and see your phone evolve the way you like. You can choose your favourite colours, draw, mix, and spray paint your phone case.

title: Gun Builder
description: Defeat all incoming enemies, and protect yourself from attacks! Pick up props to strengthen your attacks, but be careful—once your health reaches zero, the mission is over. Ready to experience the action? Play now!

title: Stick Rope Hero
description: Are you ready to become a super stickman hero? In Stick Rope Hero, you enter an exciting sandbox world filled with adventures and challenges. Swing around the open city with your powerful rope skills and completing many action tasks.

title: Fashion Valkyries Saga of Style
description: Immerse yourself in the magical world of the North to meet the northern valkyrie warriors and create relevant fashionable images for brave girls. Choose beautiful fur outfits, shining armor, and unusual accessories inspired by northern myths. Experiment with ethnic hairstyles and militant makeup. Try to assemble for each girl the perfect heroic image worthy of the harsh northern warriors!

title: Chicken Wild Run
description: Aim for the goal while collecting coins! Tap to change direction left and right. When your stamina runs out, the game is over. Get a kiss from a cute girl and become invincible! In invincible mode, you can bounce off obstacles. If you collect 10 mysterious bottles, the coins on the road will turn into high-scoring diamonds for a certain period of time.

title: Wacky Strike
description:
This time you will choose who are you actually. Well, no. Who is the strongest! Girls, or boys! So, just build a lot of towers, and buy your cool enemy! Fight like the real hero and you will cope with it, just try it!

Are you a good fighter? Then this game is for you! Just pick a side, setup your troops, and fight against your mortal enemy, do you think that it is so easy?! Then march from your castle to the enemy castle claiming ground in between.

title: Scary Baby Yellow Game
