description:
You have a new babysitting job, and things are becoming odd. Feed him, give him a bedtime tale, and avoid falling into his nightmares about him. How long can you maintain control?

Try to care for a weird infant in a lonely and unusual residence. Look for the baby in each area and follow the directions to reach your objective and finish the level.

title: From Nerds to Beauties
description: Two girlfriends, the Little Mermaid and Arlene, embark on a world of stylish transformation. Their appearance, full of flaws, requires magical intervention. In the first stage of the game, the girls go through a series of fun cosmetic procedures that give them glowing skin and luxurious hair. At the second stage, you will have to become a stylist, choosing hairstyles, fashionable clothes and accessories. Each of your actions brings the heroines closer to their dream of becoming real beauties!

title: Jump Man
description: A highly addictive endless jumper with a super cute but mischievous character! Chain combos and score as high as you can!

title: Sudoku
description: Sudoku is a relaxing yet challenging number puzzle game made for Jio feature phones. Fill the 9×9 grid with numbers 1 to 9 without repeating any in a row, column, or 3×3 box. Choose from different difficulty levels and test your logic skills. The game works offline, saves your progress automatically, and offers smooth performance with clean visuals for KaiOS devices.

title: Stack n Sort
description:
Welcome to Stack n Sort, the ultimate color stack game that combines precision, hoop sort strategy, and excitement in one addictive experience.

Immerse yourself in a world of vibrant stack color and dynamic hoop sort challenges as you test your skills and aim for high scores. Whether you’re a casual gamer or a competitive enthusiast, hoop stack offers endless fun and engagement.

title: Clownfish Pin Out
description: Clownfish Pin Out is an interesting and cute puzzle game, you need to help one little fish escape from a dangerous place. Tap the pin to make the waterfall to the fish and avoid the lava. Think before you move, or you will lose. Come on!

title: Panda Dash Auto Shooting
description: Jump straight into explosive action with Panda Dash Auto Shooting! In this fast-paced side-scrolling shooting adventure, you guide a fearless panda warrior into chaotic arenas packed with endless zombie waves. Each battle throws you into intense combat where survival depends on positioning and strategy. Every round feels stronger, faster, and more thrilling than the last! Get ready, grab your gear, and dash into zombie chaos!

title: Super Hero Driving School
description:
Drive unique super hero vehicles and perform stunts on multiple crazy tracks.

It’s a bird! No, it’s a plane! Or maybe a car? What the hell is that thing? I want to drive this right now! 

So buckle up and prepare for super fun times in Super Hero Driving School. Because even heroes need a driving license, you know! 

Drive, and fly unique super hero vehicles and perform stunts like never before. And be careful, because super heroes can have super crashes! :D

title: Tile Match Cafe
description:
Discover the engaging tile-matching puzzle game that plunges you into a world of triple-tile tapping challenges and stimulating fun.

Prepare yourself for an exciting adventure filled with complex puzzles as you match tiles, clear the boards, and strive to become the top tile master.

With its intuitive mechanics and addictive gameplay, Tile Match Cafe is an ideal pick for fans of tile-matching games seeking a charming and rewarding puzzle experience.

title: Mojicon Emoji Connect
description:
A fast, fun twist on classic Onet puzzles!
Get ready to match and relax with Mojicon: Emoji Connect – the cheerful tile-linking puzzle bursting with personality!
Connect identical emoji tiles, clear the board, and enjoy satisfying spark effects with every perfect match.
With hundreds of cute icons, calming backgrounds, and rewarding combos, Mojicon delivers endless relaxing fun for all ages.
Play anywhere, anytime – no downloads, just pure emoji joy!

title: Math Wall Simulator
description: Combine brainpower and action in this math-based Roblox adventure! Solve equations to break through walls, collect coins, and unlock new challenges. Progress through 20 classes of increasing difficulty, from basic arithmetic to extreme math puzzles

title: The White Room 5
description: The White Room 5 is the fifth sequel of an adventure escape game with a cartoon art style. Find objects that can help you escape the room and use your logic to solve the puzzles. Good luck!

title: Typing Adventure
description: Get ready for a fast-paced typing challenge in Typing Adventure! Type the words above each enemy to defeat them before they get too close. The longer you survive, the faster they come! How long can your fingers keep up? Battle endless waves and test your speed in this thrilling typing survival game!

title: Om Nom: Run
description: Om Nom: Run is a running game set on the mean streets of Nomville. Complete the set challenges on each level to succeed.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Fashion Stylist Salon Makeover
description: Do you want to create your own fashion styles? Join our best hair salon simulator game and enjoy the utmost fun. You will act as a fashion stylist who does haircuts, hairstyling, and skin care. Welcome customers with different requirements and use your hairstyling skills to make them satisfied and happy!

title: Soft Girls Winter Aesthetics
description: Hop on a plane and spend your winter vacation traveling around the world together with your favorite princesses. Discover fun winter activities and practice your fashion advisor skills while helping them choose their outfits of the day in the Soft Girls Winter Aesthetics for girls! Have a blast!

title: Feed the Parrot
description: Hello! In this exciting game you will have to help the cute parrot to fill up on delicious fruit. Combine identical fruit tiles to clear the playing field and open new levels, compete with other players, enjoy the bright pixel art and comfortable puzzle difficulty level.  Each game session offers unique challenges and colorful backgrounds, creating an atmosphere of fun and relaxation - the game is perfect for relaxing after a long day at work.

title: Tile Match Connect 3 Tiles
description:
You have to tap and match all the tiles to clear the playing field before the timer expires. It can help you focus and hone your skills to think and react quickly. Go to the unearthly world and become a master of the match 3 game genre!

Enjoy this mahjong tile matching game and enjoy moments of peace during the day to calm your mind and recharge your brain. Sharpen your mind with a series of tile matching levels that gradually increase the difficulty of the puzzle. Relax and enjoy the beautiful scenery backgrounds and use your creativity to decorate your own zen room to relax!

Let matching tiles become your new hobby for a relaxed creative mind. Come back to it every day, as there are always new daily mahjong puzzles that allow you to take care of your own houseplant and become a mahjong master!

title: Jigsort Puzzles
description: Jigsort Puzzle is an app that is art puzzle and lets you complete jigsaw puzzle game for free! Various difficulty levels for casual and experiences puzzlers!

title: Halloween Challenge
description: Get ready for a spooky adventure in Halloween Challenge! Bats are flying through the night, carrying candy that you must protect. Your mission? Tap the bats before they escape with the sweet treats. But beware, if even one bat escapes, the game is over! With simple controls and addictive gameplay, Halloween Challenge offers a fun and fast-paced experience for players. Test your reflexes, compete for high scores, and enjoy the eerie Halloween atmosphere. How long can you defend the candy?

title: Airport Security
description: Airport Security is a casual simulation game that immerses you in the high-stakes world of airport safety, placing you in the role of a vigilant security officer dedicated to safeguarding a bustling terminal. Your mission is to maintain a secure environment by identifying suspicious passengers, spotting fake passports, and uncovering hidden contraband using cutting-edge X-ray machines.

title: Space Craft: Ship War
description:
Explore deep space, piloting a cubic ship that can be infinitely expanded with modules. Collect new decks, melee and ranged weapons, boosters, and rare upgrades on the map, transforming your ship into a true battle station. Enemies also grow, making every encounter a dynamic battle for survival.

Complete levels, upgrade your stats, unlock new skins, and experiment with builds. Vibrant 3D graphics, rich effects, and constant progression make space battles exciting and unpredictable.

title: Animal Block Pop Puzzle
description: Animal Block Pop Puzzle is a fun puzzle game with cute animal-themed visuals. ??✨ Match 3+ animal-shaped blocks ?? on a grid to clear them and score points. As you progress, the game gets faster and adds new tile colors for a growing challenge. With easy drag-and-drop controls and vibrant graphics, it offers a relaxing yet exciting experience for all ages.

title: Words Match
description: This catchy combo of word search and spelling bee lets you create thousands of words with different lengths. Try to improve your score while hitting the targets presented in every unique level, and upgrade your word tiles to keep progressing! Relax and train your brain at the same time - can you pass all the levels in Words Match?

title: Arrow Tap Puzzle
description: Arrows fill the board like traffic at a silent crossing. Some lanes are open, others blocked. Remove arrows one by one, avoid blocked paths and keep your daily streak alive. Solve the arrangement in front of you, then step into another.

title: Zero to Millionaire!
description:
"Zero to Millionaire!" is an immersive life simulator where you rise from poverty to wealth! Start with simple jobs, earn your first money, and work your way up: open businesses, buy luxury houses, sports cars, stylish clothes, and build romantic relationships. Upgrade your skills, make life choices, and build a career or entrepreneurial empire. Live the life you’ve always dreamed of!
How far can you climb in Real Life?

title: Forest Tiles
description: There are several coins on the 9 by 9 playing field. It is necessary to place the blocks on the playing field in such a way as to completely assemble a vertical or horizontal line. Gold coins can be used to reset unnecessary blocks and continue the game if you lose.

title: Champions FC
description: Champions FC is a fast-paced, bite-size soccer match where you dribble, pass, and time your kicks to break through defenders and score. Play two quick halves, react to turnovers, and keep the ball in bounds. Nail the perfect moment, hear the whistle, and become Champion.

title: Obby Survive Parkour
description:
Obby Survivor Parkour is a fast-paced 3D parkour and escape game designed for players who trust their reflexes. You will test both your speed and balance skills while trying to survive in the obstacle filled course!

Each section is full of new traps and platforms that will challenge you even more. Try to survive tsunami waves, obstacle courses, lava attacks, snowball storms and red light green light game and reach the finish line.  Can you be one of the few who can reach the end of the course?

title: Domino Adventure
description: Discover three match durations to suit your style. Showcase your skills and logic in each round, and use strategic moves to outplay your opponents. Perfect for puzzle enthusiasts seeking endless fun and challenges.

title: Counter Craft Sniper
description: Counter Craft Sniper is a first-person shooter where you step into the boots of an elite sniper sent to protect a city invaded by Minecraft mobs. Creepers, skeletons, and zombies have appeared in the middle of downtown, and only your precision and quick reflexes can stop them before the chaos spreads. Armed with your trusty sniper rifle, you must take position on rooftops and high vantage points to eliminate every hostile target that threatens the civilians below.

title: Pool Master
description: From a rookie with a cue to a legend of the table, journey through 100 challenging levels with closed pockets, special balls to clear and more. Unlock custom gear, gain special boosts and rule the table with precision and power.

title: Magic Princess Dress Up Doll
description: Welcome to Magic Princess Dress Up Doll, a casual dress-up game for girl gamers. Have you ever dreamed of becoming a beautiful princess one day? Are you an enthusiast of dressing up fashion dolls? Come join us and realize all your imaginations about fashion design! This is a fashion design game where you can make up your own doll from scratch.

title: Strike Breakout
description: Strike Breakout is an intense rescue mission game where you're part of a specialized team sent to save the President and his security officers. You ride shotgun with a skilled helicopter pilot as you embark on a series of 10 nail-biting missions. Each mission drops you into enemy territory where you must stealthily navigate through enemy defenses, neutralize threats, and rescue the hostages.

title: Agent Hunt: Spy Shooter Game
description: Step into the role of an elite hitman in this tactical first-person shooter. Complete covert missions with precision shooting, stealth infiltration, and strategic planning. Use advanced sniper weapons to eliminate targets across diverse environments from cities to enemy hideouts in this action-packed spy thriller.

title: Ultimate Destruction Simulator
description: Unleash your destructive side in this ultimate demolition experience! Enjoy realistic tower destruction with dynamic physics, and take control of time—slow it down, speed it up, or freeze the action. Experiment with gravity modes, from low to high or even zero gravity, and customize every detail, including debris levels, destructibility, and atmospheric dust. Built for fans of destruction, this game offers the smash-and-crash fun you've been craving!

title: Hexa Sort: Winter Edition
description: Step into a mesmerizing world of winter puzzles with Hexa Sort! More than just a game, it’s a journey into a frosty realm where every hexagonal tile sparkles like a snowflake. Match and merge the pieces to create perfect combinations, clearing the way for new challenges as snow crystals gently dissolve.

title: Valentines Makeup Trends
description: If you're still seeking inspiration for your upcoming Valentine's Day look, then look no further Our social media influencers bring a selection of super sweet makeup looks that are going to impress your Valentine tonight. In the Valentine's Makeup Trends game for girls, you can discover the secrets of a sophisticated fantasy makeup look in candy colors. Play today and have fun!

title: Magic Beauty Makeup
description: Welcome to Magic Beauty Makeup, a casual and relaxing girl makeover game on H5games4u. The girl is in trouble with her appearance. Help her return to her original beauty with skin care and makeup methods. You will act as a makeover artist who does skin care, applies facial makeup, and designs a perfect look in the virtual fashion salon. And the best part? All the makeup procedures are done just by clicking and dragging.

title: Paper.io 2
description:
Conquer as much territory as possible and beat the competition.
A smooth drawing experience!

Use your paper block to steal the area from your online opponents in this game. Capture as much space as possible and try to get the highest score in the lobby. If you move outside your own color, your tail becomes exposed. You will be eliminated when someone manages to catch your tail. So you need to take risks to expand your colored area.

title: Hoop World 3D
description: Hoop World 3D is a flip-and-dunk game that brings basketball to a whole new dimension! Get your timing right or you'll fall short of the net and fall flat on your face.

title: Bubble Plopper
description: In Bubble Plopper you can either try to prevent the bubbles from filling the playfield in Classic mode or try to clear the playfield within the given time in Time attack mode. Shooting bubbles has never been so fun. Plop plop!

title: Car Care Repair DuDu Mechanic
description: Car Care Repair DuDu Mechanic is a casual simulation game where you act as a skillful mechanic. Your clients meet diverse problems with their cars: broken windows, cracked car doors, flat tires, malfunctioning motors, lack of car parts...

title: About a Frog
description: Jump into the world of About a Frog, a fun and free online game where you play as a brave little frog. Explore colorful levels, dodge obstacles, and enjoy the adventure on your phone or computer. It’s a light and exciting challenge for players who love quick reflexes and cute characters.

title: Escape the Horror Craft
description:
Immerse yourself in a thrilling horror adventure set in the Minecraft universe. A regular, unassuming worker in Minecraft's universe becomes disoriented and has to figure out how to get out of each level and map in order to do the jobs.

A Minecraft nightmare comes to life in this eerie, ghostly realm. Stay calm as you navigate the terrain in search of an escape. Is it possible to complete each level without dying? If you're looking for a new game to play, check out kiz10.com.

title: Fishing the Russian Way
description:
Embark on a journey through Central Russia: picturesque rivers and lakes, different types of fish, and the exciting process of fishing. Improve your tackle, control your rod, decide the fate of your catch, and add to your collection of rare finds.

Use your car to discover new locations, complete tasks, participate in tournaments, and receive daily rewards. Freedom of choice and the path to becoming a true fishing master await you!

title: Labuba Halloween Infestation
description: Monsters are invading Halloween! You must destroy them all — the fate of Halloween is in your hands. The game features three different modes, each with tougher and more powerful monsters.

title: Grass Land
description: Grass Land is a vibrant exploration game that drops you into a sprawling world of thick greenery and hidden surprises. Take control of your grass cutter, uncover valuable resources beneath the overgrowth, and build up your base as you roam the fields. Stay sharp, move fast, and make the most of every patch of grass you find.

title: Fight for the Tree
description:
The gaming world is facing a serious tree crisis. Evil forces are running wild, and the trees are in great danger.
As a player, your mission is to protect these precious trees. Even when you're offline, your character will keep fighting to safeguard the trees, constantly accumulating experience and resources.
In the game, there's also a group of cute little sapling creatures imprisoned by the evil forces. You need to rescue them one by one through battles, explorations, and so on.

title: Catch The Goose
description: Catch The Goose is a puzzle elimination mini-game. Players can tap identical items to automatically send them to the bottom slot - when three matching items gather, they get eliminated. When players successfully clear all items arranged in the grid, they get to "catch" a mischievous goose. Its addictive simplicity, stress-relieving design, and playful art style have made it a cultural phenomenon.

title: I Am Monkey
description: Enter the daily life of an adorable monkey and become its best companion in I Am Monkey! This charming game lets you explore multiple fun activities all in one place. As a delightful simulator, the game offers a variety of interactive modes. With its casual gameplay and simple controls, this game is perfect for kids and anyone who enjoys fun, lighthearted experiences.

title: Monster School vs Siren Head
Gin Rummy
description: "Gin Rummy" is a classic and engaging card game where the goal is to strategically arrange your hand into sets and runs. Place your cards in either groups of the same rank or in sequential order of the same suit. Score points by eliminating these combinations from your hand. The game ends when a player reaches the target score, typically set at 100 points.

title: CloneUp - Stack Yourself
description:
CloneUp – Stack Yourself is a 2D pixel-art platformer where your greatest tool is… yourself!

Create clones, stack them, and use them as platforms to dodge spikes, reach new heights, and make your way to the exit door.

In CloneUp – Stack Yourself, you’ll use copies of the main character to reach platforms and avoid deadly obstacles.

title: Hex Sense
description:
Guide Mochi across risky hex lands. His hex sense lets him read the numbers that give clues of how many dangers are nearby, and use them to find a safe path. Reveal tiles, flag traps, and guide brave Mochi to the Exit. 

Hex Sense is a minesweeper-style puzzle on a field of hex tiles. Some tiles hide dangerous hazards, but clues around them help you figure out where it's safe to go. Cross several unique chapters filled with new kinds of hazards and clues.

title: Granny's Classroom Nightmare
description: Step into the eerie halls of Granny's Classroom Nightmare, a horror survival game that blends the terrifying atmosphere of Granny Horror with the unsettling chill of an abandoned school. Trapped in an old, decaying classroom with Granny as your relentless pursuer, you must uncover hidden clues, solve twisted puzzles, and avoid her watchful gaze to escape. Each room holds a dark secret from a haunted past, and the slightest noise can summon Granny

title: Celebrity Spring Manicure Design
description: Step into the glamour of ‘Celebrity Spring Manicure Design’! Explore a world of trendy nail art, vibrant colors, and chic designs. Join celebrities in setting the trend for spring nails. Elevate your style with creative manicures, from floral elegance to modern motifs. Immerse yourself in the art of nail fashion and transform your fingertips into a canvas of spring-inspired beauty.

title: Float for Brainrots
description: Float for Brainrots is a chaotic water adventure game where you collect rare Brainrots across dangerous seas. Start with a simple raft, unlock powerful boats, upgrade speed and capacity, and explore deeper waters for better rewards. Manage your timer, avoid sharks, and use islands to survive. Play solo or with a friend in 2 player mode and build your ultimate Brainrot collection.

title: Fray Fight
description: Fray Fight is an action game to battle the evil hordes and annihilate thousands of monsters with overpowered attacks and upgrades. Release Date May 2022 Developer Fray Fight was developed by Playsaurus.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Crime Theft Gangster Paradise
description: Crime Theft Gangster Paradise is an action-packed gaming experience set in the neon-lit streets of Las Vegas. Players become ruthless gangsters, armed with a vast array of weapons. Engage in intense shootouts while collecting valuable loot

title: Face Changes
description: Face Changer is a fun puzzle game in which you have to correctly put together different faces in order to move to the next level or achieve new and better results in the training mode.

title: Tiny Cars
description: Tiny Cars is a colorful arcade traffic management game where players must avoid collisions. With a top-down view and engaging gameplay, this game features 50 base stages set in various locations like crossroads, squares, and highways. After completing the initial 50 levels, players will encounter the same environments with increased difficulty, offering a challenging and addictive experience for traffic control enthusiasts. Enjoy managing the traffic and becoming a master of Tiny Cars, the ultimate arcade traffic management game!

title: 3D Ball Balancer
description: 3D Ball Balancer is a fun 3D rolling ball game. Control the ball to roll on the floating bridge. There are obstacles all over the floating bridge, including broken bridges, ramps, single-plank bridges, etc. Not only do you have to control the direction of the ball, but you also have to control the speed of the ball. How far you can go? Have a try!

title: Running In Foam
description: Welcome to the wonderful world of "Running In Foam"! Everything here is made of soft, colorful foam. You'll play as a cute character, racing through foam-filled tracks. You need to nimbly jump over giant foam obstacles, slide down slippery foam slides, and collect shiny gems to unlock new characters and power-ups. The game is fast-paced with fresh, adorable graphics, and every run is full of surprises and fun. Be careful not to get lost in the foam!

title: Ninja Time
description: Immerse yourself in the world of samurai and ninjas in Ninja Time. Stretch your bamboo stick to navigate increasingly complex levels, collecting coins for new ninja skins. Experience Japan's martial arts era and become the ultimate ninja legend!

title: Practice On Me
description: Get ready for a glamorous summer adventure with Practice On Me, the ultimate makeup game! Transform into a festival goddess, beach babe, or blooming flower child in three exciting themed units. Grab your brushes, swipe on lipstick, and let your inner artist shine. Dance at festivals, relax by the beach or embrace nature's beauty. With Practice On Me, the possibilities are endless. Make waves, channel your inner mermaid, and bloom like a flower. Experience a summer adventure like no other!

title: Fun IQ Puzzle
description: Fun IQ Puzzle is a vibrant and engaging logic game that test your problem-solving skills with colorful bubble-based puzzles. In Story Mode, we have to unlock locked spaces by placing colorful puzzles in the right spots. In Time Attack Mode, we have to race against the clock to solve puzzles as quick as possible. Challenge yourself to master every stage with this fun puzzle game!

title: Match Master
description:
Match them all!
Match all same pairs in the given time to win the game and earn coins. Use various powerups to match them faster. Spen your coins to decorate your house and unlock new houses.

title: Barbee Met Gala Transformation
description: Barbee and her friends have a big night ahead—the Met Gala! It’s your job to help each of them get dressed up and feel amazing. Whether someone’s into bold colors or classic glam, you get to style their look from head to toe and make sure they’re ready to walk the red carpet.

title: Winter Gifts
description: Winter Gifts is retro a platforming-puzzle game where you grab or throw gifts. Give the gifts to children at Christmas to make them happy :).

title: FlowBall
description: Feel the adrenaline in an exciting 3D arcade game where you control a glowing ball racing through an endless tunnel! Avoid traps, chasms and obstacles, defying the laws of gravity. Your goal is to collect glowing dots to unlock new levels and set records! But be careful: falling into the abyss takes away lives, and losing them leads to defeat!

title: Moon League Sports Season
description: Under the light of the full moon, three monster-girlfriends are preparing for the brightest sports competitions of the year - the Lunar League Championship. Help the girls choose stylish sports outfits, trendy hairstyles and bright makeup for each competition. Create unique sports looks: from elegant dresses for the opening ceremony to uniforms for training. Mix colors, accessories and shoes to make each monstro-athlete shine in her own way. The Lunar League is waiting for its champions!

title: Squid Escape But Blockworld
description: You need to escape from the Squid competition, but while running away, you fell into the Block world. It’s a bit hard to escape from the Block world, but don’t stop and keep running. Never stop running until you reach the purple portal. Don’t forget to collect the money you see on the way. Be careful of the big monsters chasing you from behind; they want to catch you, and if they do, you’ll lose.

title: Stickman The Flash
description: Stickman The Flash is a fighting RPG arcade game with 2D stickman warriors. In the Survival Mode, you need to survive as long as you can by dodging red areas and killing incoming enemies. You can collect different weapons when you kill the corresponding enemies. When you earn enough gems, you can unlock and equip them in the Equipment Store, and they will increase your full abilities. Keep calm and slaughter them all!

title: Knots
description: Knots is a colorful HTML5 puzzle game for all ages! This is a simple logic puzzle where players move puzzle pieces to arrange the knot drawings correctly. Move hexagon tiles to connect matching knots and create beautiful patterns. Easy to learn, relaxing to play, and perfect for kids and adults — with lots of bright levels and fun challenges for the whole family!

title: FRAGEN
description:
FRAGEN offers intense gunfights and challenges! With dynamic game modes, you can test your skills in different ways and become the best shooter out there!
Are you ready to join the fight? Gear up, and prove your skills!

title: Room Sort
description: Welcome to Room Sort - Floor Plan Game, the ultimate free puzzle game that combines the fun of tangram puzzles with the creativity of home design. In this engaging game, you’ll rearrange room blocks to complete floor plans. Each room connects through doors, so you'll need to place them perfectly to create a cohesive layout.

title: Tail Gun Charlie
description: Tail Gun Charlie: An Epic War Simulator. Experience the thrill of flying an airplane in Tail Gun Charlie, the ultimate war simulator! Complete challenging missions and blast your enemies out of the sky! Use flexible controls to master the air combat! Are you ready for the adventure? Download Tail Gun Charlie now and have fun!

title: Gun Racing
description: Here you cannot just race with other cars, but destroy them with the help of numerous weapons. Improve your riding skills and take first places in tournaments!

title: Tony Archer
description:
Evil hooligans have caught your friends, free them quickly and punish the villains!
You are the great Tony Archer, a dude who masterfully handles all types of weapons, can run fast and is a former military man! In his hands, even a stick becomes a deadly weapon! And Tony Archer knows how to stealthily eliminate enemies. Every villain in this city will be punished and all the main character's friends will be saved! Fight on city rooftops, secret laboratories and enemy military complexes.

title: My City Hospital
description:
My City Hospital is a sophisticated digital doll placement game. Have you ever thought about being a doctor or running a hospital to help others? you can realize your dream without
leaving home. In this game, you run a large hospital with 7 management areas. In this hospital, you can help others deliver babies and take care of babies, examine patients, and help patients
with surgery.

title: Greedy Snake : Brain Hole Explosion
description: This is a level based puzzle game where players will transform into a greedy snake and challenge different levels.Players need to make flexible judgments and plan their movement paths reasonably in order to safely eat apples and reach the finish line smoothly, winning the level victory.

title: Gladiators. Merge and Fight
description: Gladiators: Merge and Fight is an engaging arcade game that combines character attribute creation and enhancement with combat. In this game, you start with basic materials and improve your gladiator's attributes by upgrading weapon, shield, armor, and helmet materials. Every decision affects your hero's stats. After preparing your gladiator, press the "Start" button to begin the second part of the game: arena battles.

title: Brainrot Click to Hatch
description: Enter Brainrot Click to Hatch, the most absurd and epic clicker at the same time. With every tap you release BRAINROTS, each one stranger and more chaotic than the last. Accumulate energy, unlock upgrades, and watch how the BRAINROTS evolve into impossible forms. From viral classics to MAX POWER versions, the challenge is clear: collect them all before losing your mind. Do you think you can dominate the Brainrot universe with just a click?

title: Help Me: Tricky Brain Puzzles
description:
Put your mind to the test in this fun and challenging brain puzzle game! ?
Solve tricky riddles, make tough decisions, and uncover mysteries in each level. From saving lives to solving absurd situations, every case challenges your logic and creativity.

title: Sprunki Monster Music Beats
description: Sprunki Monster Music Beats is a music game where popular characters create unique compositions. Combine sounds, create melodies, and enjoy!

title: The Sorting Mart
description: The Sorting Mart is a store sorting puzzle game that lets you experience the fun of shopping in a store. Rearrange items between shelves to match three identical ones on a shelf, clearing it and letting the upper shelves drop down. Clear entire stacks to shift adjacent shelves and keep matching before time runs out. If you get stuck, use the shuffle button to mix up the shelves and find matches more easily. Challenge your sorting skills as levels become more difficult!

title: Spin Spin
description: Dive into Spin & Win Arcade, the ultimate spinning challenge! Test your reflexes as you spin the wheel, dodge traps, and chase rewards. Packed with arcade action, lucky spins, and endless fun, this game keeps players hooked. Perfect for US students searching for “spin wheel game,” “lucky spin,” or “spin the wheel challenge.” Get ready to spin fast, win big, and prove you’re the ultimate spinner champion!

title: Christmas Merge
description:
The winter season has returned, and the North Pole is bustling with excitement! Get ready for festive fun with Christmas Merge!

The elves are in a frenzy, scrambling to match presents in time—merge them quickly before the frost sets in!

How many Santas can you create in one go? Play now, and let's find out!

title: Moto Attack Bike Racing
description: Moto Attack - Bike Racing is a fun bike racing simulator that takes speed and action to the next level. Drive your motorcycle and race against opponents. You can use weapons to attack them. Ride your bike through challenging tracks, and avoid obstacles like people crossing the street, cabs, boxes, etc.

title: Italian Brainrot Baby Clicker
description: Get ready for the cutest twist on the viral Brainrot universe! Italian Brainrot Baby Clicker is the baby-themed sequel to the hit Brainrot Clicker! Tap your way through the baby versions of your favorite characters, collect upgrades, and enjoy a whole new atmosphere with colorful visuals, cheerful music, and fresh sound effects designed to fit the playful baby theme!

title: Cannon Blast - The Last Stand
description: You are in control of a cannon and the enemy army is marching towards you. You have to improve your skills, collect coins to buy upgrades, and never retreat because this is The Last Stand.

title: Purrfect Puzzle
description: Purrfect Puzzle is an adorable cat-themed tile-merging puzzle game where players strategically place and combine cat tiles with different values to achieve higher scores. With relaxing pastel visuals, the game challenges players to think ahead while enjoying a cozy, heartwarming experience. Perfect for puzzle lovers and cat enthusiasts alike!

title: Cube Drop Puzzle
description:
Colorful bears are waiting to splash water!

Welcome to Cube Drop Puzzle!

Are you ready to start puzzle solving? Play Cube Drop Puzzle now and make a splash!

title: Labubu Merge
description:
Engage, Merge, and Challenge!
Dive into a labubu-matching journey where you collide identical labubu to evolve them and keep them from falling out of the box. But here's the twist: when the same labubus collide, they transform into an entirely new labubu. Can you merge your way to the grand labubu?

title: Nuts Bolts Screw Glass
description: "Nuts & Bolts: Screw Glass" is a creative puzzle game. In this meticulously designed mechanical world, you need to match different screws to their corresponding colored boxes. Every move requires careful consideration, as unmatched screws will fall into the groove at the bottom — once the groove is filled, the game is over.

title: Jungle Match Adventures
description: Jungle Match Adventures is a brand-new Match-3 game set deep in the lush Amazon Rainforest. Join the fearless explorer Aria as she uncovers hidden treasures, ancient relics, and precious gems buried in the jungle. Match colorful stones and nature-themed items, solve fun and challenging puzzles, and unlock secrets along the way. Take part in Daily and Weekly Challenges, enjoy Daily Surprises, and progress through hundreds of exciting levels in this unforgettable jungle adventure.

title: Make It Boom!
description: Explosive puzzle adventure that challenges your strategy and timing skills! Your mission is simple: burst firecrackers to create thrilling chain reactions and clear each level. But beware—this isn’t just any ordinary puzzle game!

title: Blocks Stack Rush
description: Enjoy an addictive stacking adventure. In Blocks Stack Rush, you’ll control a little block character running and begin a fun pixelated journey. Collect blocks, stack them high and race against time to build the perfect picture. You need to align each block and keep putting together the complete picture.

title: Cat Life Simulator
description:
Experience what it's like to be a cat!
- explore open world
- hunt different animals
- complete quests for different animals and people
- upgrade your skills
- get rare things for your home
- collect food and cook food
- help your cat grow up and have a family
- raise children and make them stronger
- buy items for your home
- change the appearance of your cat and the appearance of your family members
- get rewards for your achievements
- the game supports various controllers and joysticks.

title: Fishing Fishes
description:
Fish some fishes in Fishing Fishes with your fishing fishers


You'll start with a basic fishing setup, you get fishes and you can use them to buy new fishers and other upgrades that will help you get even more fish!


With intuitive controls, Fishing Fishes is a perfect game for anyone who loves fishing or management games. So what are you waiting for?

title: SPRUNKI GETS SURGERY
description:
SPRUNKI GETS SURGERY ??

OREN, a genius (but reckless) surgeon, must save PINKI after a brutal facial injury—without anesthesia! As more SPRUNKIS like TUNNER, shot in the head, flood the ER, OREN races against time. But lurking in the shadows is BLACK, ready to turn OREN’s mission into a nightmare. Will OREN save them all, or will BLACK end it in tragedy?

title: Puzzle Blocks: Fill It Completely
description:
Discover the world of exciting puzzles!

In this game, you have to collect shapes by filling them with blocks of different sizes and configurations. Each task is a unique logical task that requires attention, patience and a strategic approach.
Various difficulty levels - from easy for beginners to difficult for real masters.
Original shapes and blocks - each level is unique.

title: Party Games Mini Shooter Battle
description: Party Games: Mini Shooter Battle is a battle-royale shoot-em-up game with 2D cartoon models. In 4 modes, you can shoot other players to earn scores for coins and gems. Then you can buy more roles and guns in the Shop. Your character can aim at the closest target automatically so that you only need to fire and dodge bullets from enemies. More kills and less death will make you claim more coin and gem rewards. Good luck!

title: Spring Tile Master
description: Welcome to Spring Tile Master! Immerse yourself in the vibrant world of spring as you match tiles adorned with blooming flowers, colorful leaves, and charming insects. Draw tiles from the board to form sets of three. Keep up to 9 tiles in your stack and shuffle when needed. Collect all tiles to unlock new levels. Enjoy the enchanting springtime adventure and become the ultimate Spring Tile Master!

title: Sort Water Now
description: A fascinating puzzle journey, a mysterious water sorting adventure, waiting for your experience!Rich and fascinating levels and a variety of props combination, let the classic puzzle game take on a new look!

title: Cinderella Dress Up Girl
description: Cinderella Dress Up Girl is a stunning makeover game fit for a princess. As she prepares to attend the grand ball and meet Prince Charming, it's up to you to unleash your fashionista talent and create a stylish and glamorous outfit for her.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: CityMix Solitaire
description:
Play card games, relax and train your memory and brain with CityMix Solitaire. Solitaire CityMix is more than just another game♠♥♠♥!
Which would you prefer: decorating and restoring a quiet town, or solving puzzles and seeking adventure on a lost island? With CityMix Solitaire you can decorate, solve puzzles and mysteries, follow adventures and help brave heroes. Vicky and her pet Raccoon will help in this challenging quest.

title: Flow Block
description: Perfectly blends the classic Tetris gameplay with innovative sand flow mechanics. In the game, players not only follow the basic rules of traditional Tetris but also need to guide flowing sand particles to fill target areas.

title: Survival Racing: Extreme Road
description:
Imagine that the time has come when ordinary racing is no longer enough adrenaline temptation. In a world where extreme sports are at the peak of popularity, a new competition has appeared - Survival Racing: Extreme Road.

Overcome obstacles, avoid traps and fight your rivals to reach the finish line first. Your goal is not only to win the race, but also to survive in the face of fierce competition.

title: Hangman Saga
description: Challenge your vocabulary with Hangman Saga! With thousands of levels, each word includes a category hint to guide you—like "Profession" for "Doctor." Guess the letters wisely, but too many mistakes end the game! Need help? Use the hint button for a clue. Perfect for all ages, this fun and educational word puzzle will keep you entertained while sharpening your spelling skills. Can you solve them all?

title: TicToc Urban Outfits
description: Your favorite influencers are back, and this time, they are getting ready to have fun and dress up in urban fashion!  We've gathered four of our most fashionable BFFs to show you all their hottest looks, so join us in getting started with the TicToc Urban Fashion dress up game for girls, and have a blast choosing their outfit of the day. Experiment with different styles, play with colors and don't forget to use cool accessories for stunning urban looks.

title: LampHead
description: The main character of this game is an amazing man with a lamp instead of a head who needs to get out of a dark and dangerous strange place at any cost. Are you ready to prove that you have an outstanding reaction, maneuvering between sharp obstacles, collecting bonuses, remembering that at the end of each dark path the light of victory awaits you? We are ready to offer you a one-time runner in which tedious jumps are replaced by moving the main character between two equal planes.

title: Goods Triple Match 3D
description: Begin a super satisfying match 3 puzzle challenge. Goods Triple Match 3D is a colorful and addictive casual logic game where all items appear in beautiful and realistic 3D. Your table is filled with tons of cute 3D drinks.

title: Arrow Wave
description: Explore a world where a wave moves through various obstacles, overcoming challenges along the way. Test your reaction and perseverance!

title: Restaurant Simulator: Burgers & Pizza
description:
"Restaurant Simulator: Burgers & Pizza" is an exciting cooking and business management game where you become the owner of a fast food establishment. Prepare delicious burgers, tasty pizza, and other dishes while building a restaurant empire!

Features:
Real-time cooking - fulfill orders, combine ingredients
Varied menu - burgers, pizza, fries, drinks & desserts
Business growth - open new locations, hire staff
Economic strategy - manage finances, increase profits

title: Football Heads 2026
description: Step onto the field and dominate crazy 1v1 football matches! Outplay your opponents using powerful kicks and unique power-ups. Finally let them know who is the boss with the emotes system - become a football legend today!

title: Epic Car Stunt Race Obby
description: Epic Car Stunt Race Obby is a fast-paced, acrobatic and challenging stunt racing game. In these races with hundreds of different levels, each new track creates a completely different excitement with its special design. You can play Epic Car Stunt Race Obby against AI racers or with your friend in 2 player mode. Start the endless racing excitement now!

title: Going Balls 3D
description: Going Balls 3D is a relaxing 3D rolling game where smooth control and calm focus are the key to winning. Swipe to steer the wooden platform and guide the ball forward—no need to rush, just keep it steady and reach the finish line without falling.

title: Fennec The Fox Click Adventure
description: Embark on a cosmic adventure with Fennec the Fox! Tap your way across the desert, unlocking upgrades that transform Fennec into a powerful cosmic traveler.  Explore new worlds, face thrilling challenges, and evolve Fennec to reach the stars. Can you guide Fennec to the farthest reaches of the universe? Start clicking and discover the wonders that await!

title: Student and Teacher
description:
The school is not ready for you!
Broken laptops, chairs in splinters, the dining room is looted!
Revenge is a dish served in the form of chaos!
Forget about the silent protest – only crushing anarchy!
Make your classmates regret it!
The teacher is in a panic!
The head teacher is furious!
The main thing is not to get caught and avenge the setup!

title: CodeQuest
description:
CodeQuest is a cyberpunk adventure game where you learn 
real Python programming by writing actual code to defeat 
enemies and save the Digital World! Write Python code to 
power your hero across 10 missions. No prior coding 
experience needed.

title: Merge Magnat - IDeaL Store
description: Welcome to the world of trade, where you can create your own shopping district! In this engaging game, you will build the area by placing various shops and attracting customers who will spend money. Merge similar shops to create higher-level versions that yield more profit. Watch as customers pass by your stores, leaving money while you relax and enjoy the game.

title: Animal Blocks
description: Enter the colorful and cheerful world of Animal Blocks, where adorable creatures bring classic block puzzles to life. Match three or more of the same animal blocks to clear the board, earn points, and climb to higher scores. Simple to play yet full of fun challenges, this free online game is perfect for both mobile and desktop players who enjoy relaxing, strategic gameplay and charming visuals.

title: Merge Squares
description: "Merge Squares" is an exciting puzzle game, where your task is to connect squares with same numbers. Using logic and strategic mind, you have to decide how to arrange the squares to combine them into one. Each level gets harder, how far can you go?

title: Eat Donuts
description: Swap, rotate, and smash colorful donut rings in a vibrant 3x3 grid to create explosive matches and devour points like never before. Start with easy levels like our sunny beachside challenge—rack up scores to hit that juicy target of 800, earn shiny coins for power-ups like the mighty hammer smash or speedy rotates, and unlock endless waves of mouthwatering fun.

title: Crazy Bar Brawl
description: Crazy Bar Brawl ?? throws you straight into the most chaotic, hilarious, and action-packed bar battles ever! If you’ve ever wondered what would happen if you walked into a bar full of drunk troublemakers ?, flying bottles ?, wobbling chairs ?, and wild characters who can barely stand… well, now you can experience it ALL—safely, virtually, and with maximum comedy!

title: Happy Fluffy Cubes
description: Happy Fluffy Cubes is a bright and fun 3D runner with adorable cube heroes, tricky traps, and a collection system! Choose your Fluffy and fly through levels full of danger: fire, ice, lasers, and spinning saws! Simple one-touch control, but surviving takes focus and reflexes.

title: Chicken Wars Merge Guns
description: The lands of the chickens are under attack. They are trying to defend themselves with their guns. Help them! It is a tower defense game in which you merge chickens and create more powerful chickens to defend your lands. The enemy will come over you wave by wave. Make sure they don't break your defense.

title: 2020 Connect
description:
2020 Connect is the most addictive logic puzzle you’ve ever seen! The player’s task is to place at least four blocks with the same number on it next to each other so they get merged. 2020 Connect takes the best ideas of games like Merged and 2048 and turns it into a total blast. Merging more than four blocks will reward you with coins that later can be spend to purchase cool boosters. 
Will you be able to get the legendary 8192 blocks to merge?

title: Popping Pets
description: In Popping Pets, stack and match adorable pets to score points! Connect three or more adjacent pets to clear them before time runs out. Look out for bombs for big clears and big points. Can you reach the highest score in one minute?

title: Magic Tiles 3
description:
Love music games? Play your favorite songs on Piano Magic Piles 3!
Magic Tiles 3 is an engaging music game that combines magic piano, rhythm, and games for a fun and immersive experience. Tap the tiles to the beat, challenge your reflexes, and enjoy a massive library of 45,000+ songs across various genres, pop, EDM, hip-hop, and more! Tap the black tiles to the rhythm while avoiding the white ones.
Support email: magictiles3.support@amanotes.com

title: Blankets
description:
Put together cozy blanket pieces with the same colors and patterns to make them disappear and keep your board nice and neat!
With soft colors and a calm, happy feel, Blankets is great for kids who like fun puzzles without too much stress.

Can you build the coziest blanket and get the best score in Blankets?

title: Hero Wizard: Save Your Girlfriend
description: One day when I woke up, I saw that my girlfriend wasn't beside me, so I started searching around for her but couldn't find her. Then I noticed a letter on the table, and the letter said: "If you want to see your girlfriend again, you'll have to pass through the magic forest to rescue her, but it won't be easy because you're not alone in the forest!" At first, I didn't understand, but..

title: Block Blast Jewel Puzzle
description: Block Blast: Jewel Puzzle is a vibrant block-stacking game that mixes calm strategy with thrilling speed. Fit jewel blocks to clear lines in Classic, Timer, or Level modes. Easy to start, tough to master, and super satisfying—compete worldwide and climb the leaderboard!

title: Stickman Prison Escape
description: Stickman went back to prison for committing a minor crime. It's time to find a successful way to escape from this cold, gray prison. Guards and other difficulties await you along the way. There will be a choice of 3 items that the guard brought hidden in the pumpkin. It's Halloween time and pumpkin will help Stickman successfully escape prison.

title: Escape or Die - Troll Devil Levels
description: Escape or Die: Troll Devil Levels, you’re thrust into a nightmarish world where trolls, twisted by ancient demonic curses, guard labyrinthine dungeons filled with deadly traps and unspeakable horrors. Your mission? Escape each level with devil alive— or end up as another soul devoured by the Troll Devil’s wrath. With ever-changing challenges and escalating danger, only the quickest, smartest, and bravest will survive.

title: Backrooms Among Impostor & Rolling Giant
description:
Now you must escape from Impostor Among Us and Rolling giant.
But beware granny sometimes accidentally appear to haunt you!
Grab all phone before time run out and call your friend to help you!

title: Build and Run
description: Experience the ultimate blend of running and building in our action-packed game! Navigate through exciting levels by constructing missing parts of the level while running at full speed. Master using horizontal builds, slopes, and ramps to keep moving forward and avoid dangerous traps.

title: Panda Lu Treehouse
description: Hey, animal lovers! Enter the enchanting world of Panda Lu's Tree House, a super fun casual simulator that will warm your heart. In this game, you play as the caretaker of the adorable panda Lu. Your adventure begins by building a magnificent tree house, a cozy and vibrant home for your furry friend.

title: My Arcade Center
description: My Arcade Center is a fast-paced management game where you build and expand your own arcade. Earn tokens by day, upgrade machines by night, hire staff, use coin bots, and handle freeloaders and vandals. Unlock new machines, optimize layouts, manage customer behavior, and progress through 9 handcrafted maps for long-term growth.

title: Mini Golf Saga
description: Embark on an immersive golf adventure with Mini Golf Saga, a captivating 3D mini-golf game set against the backdrop of a picturesque beach, featuring diverse golf levels where precision is key to achieving the lowest hit count for a high score; facing limited hits per level, strategize your shots wisely and, when needed, watch a rewarded video ad to replenish your chances and continue the saga of sun-soaked golfing excitement.

title: Obby Tower
description:
Climb. Think. Survive.

Ascend a towering obstacle course filled with tricky jumps, moving platforms — and surprise math challenges! Combine your parkour skills with quick thinking to make it to the top.

Perfect for players who love obbies and want to test both reflexes and brainpower.

title: Stickman Halloween Survive
description:
Now that Halloween is here, the gloomiest day of the year, it's time to bring back the courageous white stickman who is an expert at vanquishing monsters. Stop procrastinating and start enjoying Stickman Halloween Survive right now on your preferred mobile device. It's a fun and free online game. 
Every living thing on Earth is frightened to death when monsters emerge from their underground lairs on Halloween night.

title: Fruit Jam - Merge Puzzle Game
description:
Fruit Jam - Merge Puzzle Game
Swipe fruits, blast combos & solve hundreds of juicy match-3 puzzles! Fun for all ages with vibrant graphics, daily rewards, offline play & no time limits. ?? Perfect for quick play or long sessions. Match, crush & enjoy!

Play now and test your brain!

title: Save my Hero
description:
Players may enjoy a unique gaming experience in Save my Hero Online, an engaging puzzle game that revolves on drawing lines. You take on the role of a superhero under assault from missiles in the game. It is your responsibility to create lines to stop these projectiles and shield the hero.

Finish every level and attempt to rescue the superheroes, such as Iron Man, Batman, Spider-Man, and so on.

title: Cryptogram
description:
This game is for people who do not just look at letters but see the meaning behind them.
Each phrase hides a thought that can be revealed if you use logic, intuition and persistence.

title: Infinite Craft
description: This is a crafting game in which you start with four elements - Fire, Earth, Water, and Wind. Combine elements to create new elements. Find bizarre and fun combos. Enjoy an open and stress-free exploration experience.

title: Sweet Merge
description: Dive into 'Sweet Merge', a relaxing and delightful game where your goal is simple: merge and combine an assortment of sweets like jellies, cakes, and candies to create a new bigger sweet. How large can you make your sweet merge?

title: Tower of Hell: Obby Blox
description: Tower of Hell skill game, classic mode from your favorite game right in the browser on your computer and phone!

title: Obby Massive Attack
description:
Help the Obby blox friends to rescue the hapless citizens of a city. During the adventure, you'll get bonuses that give you superpowers that will allow you to sweep aside everything in your path.
Obby Masive Attack is the ideal game for anyone who loves the running game genre. This time, Obby and friends are the protagonist - the game offers fast gameplay, nice graphics, special effects and good playability.
Collect coin and buy new power ups, and run forever in this fantastic endless adventure.

title: Parking Driver
description: Ever struggled to find a parking spot? In "Parking Driver," you'll face tricky parking challenges! From tight parallel parking to complex reverse maneuvers, you need precise control to avoid obstacles and park perfectly in the shortest time. The game features a realistic physics engine and diverse level designs, each testing your patience and skill. Come prove your driving prowess, unlock cool new cars, and conquer every parking lot!

title: Army Truck Driver Online
description: Take control of a cargo army truck in a military game and deliver high-ranking soldiers to their camp. Carrying out your assignment as an army truck driver cargo in this military game is no easy feat, especially when you're an officer. The highways are filled with hazards and obstacles.

title: Hard Rock Zombie Truck
description:
We ride on the roof of a truck, shoot, blow up and crush zombies!
This is a 2D shooter where you need to destroy crowds of zombies and monsters by shooting, crushing and exploding them. At the same time, it is necessary to save living people. We also upgrade our weapons and abilities! Lots of funny sounds, lots of blood (cartoonish!!!) and humor.

title: Watermelon merge
description:
In this exciting game you will plunge into the fascinating world of combining different fruits. When they collide, they combine to create entirely new fruit combinations.

Start your journey with small and juicy fruits, combine them to create larger and more unique varieties. Your goal is to reach the magnificent watermelon that will be the culmination of your fruit adventure.

title: Match 3D Puzzle Saga
description: Ready to match and collect? Solve puzzles to earn coins, unlock powerful power-ups and complete daily challenges to grab extra rewards and sweet bonuses. The more you play, the more opportunities you have to boost your score!

title: Stacking Match
description: Jenga match is a very fun puzzle game. Players need to pull out blocks of a certain color from a multi-layered tower of blocks. The pulled block will fly into the corresponding colored square. When there are three blocks of the same color in a square, it will eliminated, and a new square will appear. How many levels you can play?

title: Stickman Escape School
description:
You have to play a student stick who does not like to go to school. Student stickman tired of so much to learn and listen to boring instructors from the stereotypical thinking that the student decides to escape.
While the teacher left the class student teacher decided to see a box and terrified. In the box were a lot of different items. The student not long thinking decided to take advantage of these tools to escape from the school.

title: Photo Block Journey
description: Move picture blocks across the board and place them in the right order to complete the image. Look carefully at the layout, plan your moves, and find the best way to solve each puzzle. The gameplay is simple from the first level: slide the tiles, open the path, and complete the picture.
