title: Steal Brainrot Monsters!
description:
Step into a world of fun, charm, and Italian flair with Buy Cute and Funny Animals! From the tiny and delightful Nubini Pizzanini to the rare and majestic Tralalelo Tralala and the playful Los Tralalelitos, there’s no shortage of adorable creatures to collect.

Build your very own cozy base, place your animals in it, and make them feel right at home. In return, they’ll reward you with coins, which you can use to unlock even more animals and exciting upgrades.

title: Restaurant VIP Masterchef
description: Restaurant VIP is a game where you have to run a restaurant and bring your management skills to every diner! Survive the daily target to get high score.

title: Mahjong Crimes - Puzzle Story
description:
MYSTERIOUS FEATURES

Play 100+ Mahjong exciting levels! 
Dive into Agatha Christie's stories 
Use boosters and collect tile sets

PLAY MAHJONG

Mahjong Crimes is a puzzle game where you match tiles to find clues and solve crimes. Use power-ups to beat tricky levels and win awards!

SOLVE CRIMES

Join detective Hercule Poirot on the Orient Express to solve crimes in this Mahjong game! Match tiles to investigate, defeat thugs, and untangle mysteries. Fun guaranteed!

title: Crafty Town Merge City
description: The latest strategy is here! If you want to build a town or rule your own kingdom, do it now! Here, you can build a house and turn it into the biggest castle in your kingdom. If you like architecture or strategy games, I guess you do, you will have a good time! Playing the new kingdom builder is absolutely free! Make your empire great!

title: Garage Master - Nuts and Bolts
description:
Your goal as a Garage Master is to sort out nuts by color to corresponding bolt. Sounds easy, doesn't it? Think twice! The color sort game presents a challenges by mixing all the nuts and making it difficult to find the corresponding bolt.
It’s a perfect time to train your problem-solving abilities in this color sort game.
The best part is when your car is finished, open my super garage and customize it by choosing one of 4 skins.

title: Planet Takeover
description: take command of your interstellar empire and set out to conquer the entire galaxy! Forge strategic alliances that can be either your greatest asset or, under the cover of darkness.

title: Lollipop Stack Run
description: Dive into a sweet adventure in Lollipop Stack Run which is a colorful parkour game! In this fun arcade game, keep running while collecting vibrant lollipops to stack your sweet tower. You need to be flexible and glide between various obstacles, making sure to collect as many lollipops as possible during the run.

title: Unblock It 3D
description:
Power up your logic and spatial reasoning skills with Unblock It 3D! Rotate the cluster of bricks to find unblocked tiles you can slide away without hitting any obstructions. 

Play Classic Mode and enjoy hundreds of intricate puzzles with unlimited moves, new cube designs and backgrounds to unlock.

Or, journey through time in Adventure Mode. Try your hand at 25 additional levels of increasing complexity and size. Explore Ancient Egypt, Medieval Europe, the Aztec Empire, feudal Japan, and more.

title: My Farm Empire
description: My Farm Empire is a fun and relaxing game that lets you create your own farm paradise on a beautiful island. You will become a farmer and grow various crops, from fruits and vegetables to flowers and herbs. You will also enjoy the stunning graphics, the smooth gameplay, and the rewarding progression system that will make you feel like a real farmer. My Farm Empire is more than just a game, it’s a lifestyle. Join the My Farm Empire today and start your farming adventure.

title: Zombies Weapon Merge 4
description: Zombies are swarming. Are you ready to fight back? Zombies 4 – Weapon Merge is an exciting shooting and strategy game where every decision matters. Match and merge weapons to create powerful guns, then aim and shoot endless waves of zombies. Combine identical weapons, upgrade your firepower, and place them smartly to survive tougher enemies.

title: Hero Fight Clash
description: A thrilling adventure, hearty duel, don't you want to play a horizontal fighting game like Hero Fight Clash? Various cool skills, choose your favorite hero, keep adventuring, keep upgrading, and defeat more powerful enemies.

title: Princesses at Horror School
description: In this game you will meet two charming monster girls who study at a school for young monsters. Every morning, the girls carefully think over their images, mixing elements of a classic princess and a creepy monster. Girls have different fashion preferences, but they have one thing in common - these two unusual girlfriends always attract the admiring glances of classmates. After all, they are not just princesses, but real monsters whose terrifying style makes even the bravest tremble!

title: Merge Car Defense
description:
Prepare to battle wave upon wave of relentless enemies as you skilfully merge and upgrade the defences of your cars.

Build out a roster of cars and use them tactically in order to defeat the enemy, collect coins and be victorious!

title: Tanks
description: Tanks is a fast-paced arcade shooter where you control a powerful tank and battle through maze-like stages. Destroy enemy tanks, defend your base, and survive waves of attacks. Each level introduces new challenges that require quick reflexes and smart strategy. Easy to play but hard to master, Tanks offers fun and engaging gameplay for casual players.

title: Circuit Master
description: Circuit Master is a puzzle game where you aim to get a green light by connecting the circuit correctly! Arrange the wires, fans, and machines in the right places, then turn on the button to see the electricity flow. Only the correctly connected circuit will make the green light shine. Use hints if you need help.

title: Dark Stones: Card Battle RPG
description: Dark Stones: Card Battle RPG is a strategic card-based battle game set in a dark fantasy world of magic and elemental forces. Assemble a team of humans, orcs, mages, elves, and other creatures to defeat powerful foes, capture their souls, and unlock new powers.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: RobyBox - Space Station Warehouse
description:
Your main task is to place boxes in their designated places to open doors and advance through the levels. Be on the alert! Aggressive bots will chase you. You can destroy them with a powerful arsenal including drill, disks, mines and rockets. Traps are scattered throughout the levels - use them to your advantage by luring the bots into dangerous areas. 
When you need a break from the intense gameplay, head to the warehouse where you can earn gold and solve Sokoban-style puzzles in peace.

title: Hospital Game Happy Clinic
description: Welcome to Hospital Game: Happy Clinic, a casual hospital simulation game, where you run a hospital and give treatment to all your patients. Want to elevate your hospital services and cure more patients? Start with your first treatment in the clinic! The more patients you have cured, the more coins you get to update your hospital.

title: Military Cubes 2048
description: A game in the genre of 2048. Skillfully use the game physics to your advantage. The goal of the game is to connect the cubes to the maximum number 2048 and not to lose. There is a booster in the game, which will make it fun and easier to pass the game.

title: Tile Sort - Match 3
description: Tile Sort - Match 3 is an addictive match-3 puzzle game where your task is to sort and match identical tiles on the board. The game combines classic match-3 gameplay with elements of sorting, adding an extra layer of strategy and logic. Move tiles, creating combinations of three or more identical tiles to clear the board.

title: Rocket Fest
description: Control the rocket to collect energy or other useful props along the way, and bomb the target at the end! This is a casual stress relief game.

title: Cube in Cube
description: Play the new 2048 game with unique mechanics! Develop strategies to clear cubes in endless mode or rescue the monkey. Challenge yourself now!

title: Jewel Legend Quest
description: The most legendary quest of your life begins! Miners from all around the world have come to get their hands on these precious gems. Join them in the effort and engage in various challenges while trying to dig out as many diamonds as possible.

title: ZombCopter
description: Enter the Zombcopter, a helicopter tricked out with more weapons than you can shake a rotting limb at. Your mission? Defend the last remaining intact City Hall from an endless horde of zombies. As the intrepid shooter in the Zombcopter, it's up to you to mow down waves of funny-looking zombies. You'll have plenty of zany upgrade choices to turn the tide of undead insanity in your favor. Get ready to laugh, shoot, and upgrade your way through the wackiest zombie apocalypse ever in Zombcopter.

title: Horror Minecraft Partytime
description: Horror Minecraft Partytime is a spooky and interesting horror survival game. This time you will enter a familiar world of blocks. In this hide-and-seek mode, you will be the pursuer, looking for every corner. Find the weirdo in disguise and catch him.

title: Drawing Squares
description:
Drawing Squares is the logic game that will blow your mind!
It is a logic game inspired by the classic pen and paper game Dots and Boxes. Do you remember the game you used to play at school? (also known as Boxes, Squares, Paddocks, Pigs in a Pen, Square-it, Dots and Dashes, Dots, Smart Dots, Dot Boxing, or, simply, the Dot Game).

title: Travel with Me: ASMR Edition
description: Travel with Me: ASMR Edition is a dress-up game where you join stylish vlogger Lisa on a global adventure. From Thailand's serene temples to Dubai's desert escapades and the Maldives' tropical paradise, dress her in fabulous outfits that match each stunning destination.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Animal Racing Idle Park
description: Animal Racing: Idle Park is an addictive racing animal transform game that will keep you playing for hours. In this game, you’ll train multiple animal racers such as lions, eagles, orangutans, dolphins, and more!

title: Save Baby Capybaras - Pull Pin
description:
“Save Baby Capybaras - Pull Pin” is a cute puzzle game where you must figure out which pins to pull in order to rescue the baby capybaras and bring them to their father capybara. Be strategic, as some pins don’t need to be pulled, while others can disrupt your game. Unlock character skins using the rubies you earn and challenge yourself across various levels!
Enjoy the game and raise your name on the global leaderboard!

title: Ball and Girlfriend
description:
Our ball's girlfriend is in danger! They lock her in a cage and hide the key! You need to find the key and save your beloved Girlfriend!
There are many levels, different locations, enemies, dangerous obstacles, good graphics and much more!
There will be a boss in the last level!
Collect hearts to increase your health!
There are 3 difficulty levels to choose from!
There is one hidden emerald in each level, find the secret passage to it!

title: Butterfly Sort Puzzle
description:
Various kinds of butterflies sitting on leaves.
Shy butterflies can only fly next to friends of the same kind.
Bring its friends to one leaf and fly them together~

title: Furry Kung Fu
description: Furry Kung-Fu & Babushka is a humorous fighting game with fun cartoon graphics, where controlling Cat or Babushka you need to inflict the enemy a series of hand-to-hand strikes, managing to dodge the sinister ball and sausage, which every second flies at you. Engage in epic hand-to-hand combat with park troublemakers. Earn achievements, get coins, unlock player skins! Will you be able to throw enemy sausage back at them? How long can you hold out? It's time to find out!

title: Draw War
description: Unleash your creativity in Draw War. This is a wonderful strategy game. Here drawing meets battles. Build a hero lineup, draw your legions, then unleash the power of your army. The numbers show the soldiers summoned. Click to send Shielded Soldiers, Soldiers on Horseback, or Super Beasts.

title: Fruit Balls: Juicy Fusion
description:
Discover the exciting world of juicy fruits! The task is simple: connect identical fruits to create ever larger and tastier associations, heading towards the treasured watermelon.

- Click on the field
- Connect identical fruits
- Create combinations to get bigger fruits.
- Reach the last level
- Don't let the container overfill
- Earn money for new skins and try to pass with them ???

title: Mahjong Riddles: Egypt
description:
Welcome to the mysterious world of Ancient Egypt! Find matching tiles, solve mahjong levels and collect artifacts to uncover secrets of Giza valley, Old city, Desert and Nile.
Discover how the Great Pyramid of Giza was constructed, how Egyptians learned to read hieroglyphs, why only the pharaoh could own a cat in Ancient Egypt and many more. 
Simple and engaging gameplay of mahjong solitaire is the best way to relax. You will find huge treasures, tricky locks, new bonus tiles and more.

title: Santa Go
description:
Santa Go is a cozy Christmas puzzle game where you help Santa reach his sleigh!
Draw a line for Santa to slide along and watch him glide under a cheerful holiday melody.
Be careful — with each level, more obstacles appear, and they can easily knock Santa down.
Your goal is to guide him into the sleigh and keep him there for 3 seconds to complete the level!

title: Marble Sort
description: Marble Sort is a fun and satisfying puzzle game where colorful marbles travel along a conveyor belt waiting to be sorted. Fill matching trays, complete sets of three identical marbles, and clear every level. Plan your moves carefully, manage the flow, and enjoy smooth animations, relaxing gameplay, and rewarding sorting challenges. Easy to learn, hard to master!

title: Cinema Empire Idle Tycoon
description: Welcome to Cinema Empire Idle Tycoon! Do you dream of owning your own movie theater empire? Now's your chance! In this super fun idle simulation management game, you'll start with a small screening room! Build your own cinema empire! As a theater owner, you need to manage every aspect of the theater. Unlock the theater's facilities, ticket booths, movie halls, dining areas, and more. Hiring employees to help you get more bang for your buck.

title: SLIDE STONE
description: Horisontally slide the blocks and create a complete row across the board. Every time you slide a block and additional blocks are added from the bottom of the board. If you create multiple rows simultanepusly or create a row consecutively that becomes a COMBO! Good luck and let's aim for the high score!

title: Cuphead
description: Cuphead is a sidescrolling action game developed by StudioMDHR. Play one of the biggest boss battles where you control a warplane carrying Cuphead.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Labubu Doll Mukbang Asmr Unblocked
description: Welcome to Labubu Doll Mukbang Asmr Unblocked, a charming, casual ASMR game that combines the joy of food, cooking, and ASMR sounds! Experience as a talented baker and join the lovely Labubu on a mouthwatering adventure. In the game, you will take orders from your diners, each with unique requests for bread. From croissants to loaves of baguettes, you need to pack each bread for your customers on time.

title: Canasta Royale Offline
description:
Canasta is the most traditional and loved card game by all. It is an exciting mix of strategy, luck and skill.Canasta uses two complete decks of 52 playing cards (French Deck) plus the four Jokers. All the Jokers and twos are wild cards.

Game Features:
★ 2 or 4 players
★ Clockwise or Counter-Clockwise
★ Game is automatically saved each turn, so you can close it and continue playing later
★ Undo function so you can cancel mistaken melds

title: Find The Cat - Cat Search
description: Discover the exciting world of finding hidden cats in this original puzzle game! Look for cats on black and white backgrounds by tapping on them to complete levels. With each stage, you will unlock new places and receive unique challenges that will test your attentiveness and observation skills.

title: Beat Music Battle
description: Step into the world of Beat Music Battle: 456 Survival, where rhythm meets creativity and fun! This casual music game is perfect for puzzle enthusiasts and party lovers alike.

title: DIY Makeup Salon - SPA Makeover Studio
description:
Have you ever dreamt of becoming a fashionable DIY make-up stylist in the beauty makeup artist’s salon?

Welcome to the DIY Makeup Salon: SPA Makeover- a fascinating beauty salon game, where you can create fun-filled makeovers for pretty girls! You can showcase your skills as a make-up stylist in our salon. Make use of various tools and facial cleansers to give your model a refreshing skin makeover. There are numerous dress up designs to explore for a flawless make up look!

title: Zombie Outbreak Survive
description: With this entertaining game you will have to run throughout the city, run and shoot because the zombies are fast and dangerous, they will not stop chasing you to devour you.The zombie apocalypse has arrived and the terror of surviving has arrived with this new game. Zombie Outbreak Survive is a 3D game with impressive and realistic graphics that will make your hair stand on end and you will feel the true fear of being devoured.

title: Blob Hero
description: In Blob Hero, you become a brave hero facing endless waves of enemies and monsters! This survival game offers a true rogue adventure experience. You control a blob hero, choose basic skills and upgrade to survive.

title: Match-3: Dream Room
description: Assemble the dream room and show your friends how to transform the space with clever combos! Join Match-3: Dream Room and create your dream room by solving puzzles and enjoying the exciting process of furnishing!

title: Stickman Jailbreak Story
description:
An exciting puzzle game in which the player will have to help stick make a daring escape from prison. Stick found himself in a sinister prison, from which there is no way out, except for various ingenious paths, hidden objects and puzzles.
The player will explore the various rooms of the prison, paying attention to every small detail and examining objects in search of key clues. Each room is filled with riddles, traps and various items that can be used to escape.

title: Pull The Pins
description: Pull the Pins is a strategic puzzle game where you must carefully pull pins in the correct order to rescue a young boy and make him reach his brother. Each decision matters, as a wrong move could lead to failure. Plan your actions wisely and use problem-solving skills to ensure a successful rescue.

title: Water Sort - Collections
description: Sort, pour, and relax! Complete each level by filling bottles and unlock beautiful collectible images. Test your logic, calm your mind, and build your own gallery as you master the art of sorting water!

title: Deadflip Frenzy
description:
Deadflip Frenzy is a wild stunt-flipping action game where chaos meets style! Launch your character into the air, pull off insane flips, twists, and bone-crunching landings — all in the name of fun (and maybe a little destruction).

Bounce off trampolines, launch from cannons, smash through obstacles, and aim for the most outrageous combos. The more insane your flip, the higher your score. But beware — one bad landing and it’s ragdoll mayhem!

title: BlockPuzzle : Color Blast
description:
"Block Puzzle" is a fun and classic block game!
And our Block Puzzle is not just that. It is more Simple and addictive! Once you start, you will not stop playing. Just have a try, you will love it!

title: Papa Buzja
description:
Papa Buzja brings good things home! He feeds the children, brings them books, makes supplies and builds a house. The path will pass through wide fields, dense forest, squelching swamp and high mountains.
Difficultes and adventures await Papa Buzja along the way. 
Whatever happens on the way, remember: the kids are waiting for you!

title: Blue VS Red
description: Sort blue and red items as fast as you can! Drag or use arrow keys to send each item to the correct zone. Build combos, beat the timer, and earn coins to buy power-ups. Challenge yourself in solo mode or compete against AI bots. How high can you score in 30 seconds?

title: Bolt Climb: Tap to the Top
description: Bolt Climb: Tap to the Top is an addictive one-touch climbing game where you control a cute bolt on a mission to climb as high as possible! Just tap and hold to rise — the higher you go, the harder it gets. Can you set a new record?

title: Merge 2048 Cake
description:
Merge 2048 Cake is a colorful and relaxing puzzle game where you merge matching tiles to create higher numbers!
Combine three or more identical tiles to form a new one with double the value. Plan your moves, trigger satisfying chain reactions, and aim for the ultimate 2048 tile!
Enjoy smooth gameplay, vivid visuals, and a cozy, casual vibe that’s easy to play and hard to put down.

title: Tap Block Puzzle: Smash Game
description:
Tap Block Puzzle: Smash Game is a satisfying and addictive puzzle game where you tap on two or more matching blocks to smash them!
? Clear the board, create massive combos, and reach high scores in this colorful, fun-packed block smashing experience.
Perfect for casual players and puzzle lovers alike!

title: Unlock the Bolts
description: Unlock the Bolts is a challenging puzzle game where you carefully remove screws to solve mechanical puzzles. Each level tests your logic and precision as you figure out the correct order to unlock the bolts. In special levels, the stakes are even higher—you must free trapped animals by unlocking the right bolts! With satisfying mechanics and engaging challenges, this game will keep you thinking and entertained. Can you master every puzzle and rescue the animals in need?

title: Hamstercycle
description:
Help a genius hamster bust out of a mad professor's lab on his slick DIY ride - the Hamstercycle!

Jump across furniture and whatever junk the prof left lying around to reach the portal at the end of each room. But watch out - the floor is guarded by laser sensors! Touch it, and the hamster gets caught!

Fun physics, simple controls, and hundreds of exciting levels await!

title: Cube to Hole Puzzle
description:
Welcome to Cube to Hole Puzzle!
Get ready for an exciting and brain-teasing experience! In Cube to Hole Puzzle, your objective is simple: fill the colored cubes into their matching colored holes. But there’s a catch—limited space on the board and only a few slots to move the cubes forward. You’ll need to plan ahead and choose the right cube to move first. Strategize carefully to avoid blocking yourself and clear the board to progress through each level!

title: Flower Shop
description: Match 6 of the same flowers to ship them! You can place your flowers in any empty spot on the board. Place a flower next to a tray with the same kind to make them merge. When the right conditions are met, customers will come by to visit! Complete their requests to earn rewards. The game ends when there’s no more space left to place flowers.

title: Obby Tower Parkour Climb
description:
Dive into the parkour adventure with Obby in the Hell Tower game theme. Climb colored platforms and get to the finished platform for a great reward.
The game contains three hell tower maps easy, medium, and hard. Play these maps in two different modes normal mode and challenge mode. Try to do your best timing in challenge mode in either single-player or 2 player game mode. You can also compete against your friend in normal mode in the 2-player game mode option.

title: Space Survivor
description: Jump right into the action, fighting dangerous aliens and executing amazing maneuvers! Sharpen your weapons and skills, you will need them to last as long as possible.

title: Bubble Shooter Wonders of Egypt
description: Journey into an ancient Egyptian night in Bubble Shooter Pyramid Quest! Match and pop glossy bubbles to climb rising score goals. Fill the goal bar to trigger quick celebrations, then push onward as the ceiling creeps closer. Beat your High score, earn a second chance with a rewarded continue, and watch desert backdrops shift as you progress. Easy to start, hard to master—aim, bounce, and clear your way to legend! Start in Beginner, then unlock Medium and Hard as your score surges ever higher!

title: Kitten Never Dies
description: Join an interdimensional adventure to help a lost kitten find its way home! Solve unique challenges in each dimension. Cute, clever, and full of surprises—are you up for the challenge? Play now and test your puzzle-solving skills!

title: Archer: Dungeon Hero
description: A fast-paced fantasy roguelike where an archer battles waves of monsters, unlocks abilities, and creates a unique build during every run.

title: Push.io
description: Push.io is a fast-paced arena game where you battle to stay on the map and push everyone else off. Wield your boomerang with precision to knock rivals into the water while dodging incoming attacks. The longer you survive, the higher you rank; fall early, and you’ll drop in the standings. Earn trophies, upgrade your boomerang between rounds, and rise through the ranks to become the ultimate arena champion.

title: Gas Station: Junkyard Tycoon
description: Build Your Dream Gas Station and Garage Tycoon Empire! Take charge in Gas Station Simulator Inc., the ultimate game for oil tycoon enthusiasts, idle games managers, and aspiring entrepreneurs! Manage, rebuild, and expand the gas station simulator, clean up your junkyard, and fix cars in this immersive and rewarding gas station simulator.

title: GMOD Bombs
description:
Experience the power of a high-tech laser cannon in the GMOD Bombs! Collect bombs, create cities, and aim to destroy objects on the map and enjoy spectacular explosions.
GMOD Bombs is an exciting game where you take on the role of a bombardier armed with a futuristic laser cannon. Your task is to collect bombs and strategically destroy various objects and structures on the map. Each bomb has a unique flight trajectory and blast radius, which requires precision and aiming skills.

title: Stick Man Battle Fighting
description: Enter the world of Stick Man Battle Fighting and every move matters! This casual fighting game lets you unleash your skills in dynamic stickman battles against enemies. Master various fighting styles and begin exciting single-mode combat. Choose a weapon and customize your hero.

title: Farmer Rush: Idle Farm Game
description: The combination of merging crops, upgrading your farm, and the satisfaction of watching your fields bloom makes this game a perfect pick for players who love farming sims or idle games.

title: Mahjong Earth
description: Immerse yourself in the serene beauty of Mahjong Earth! This captivating game offers a tranquil escape with its soothing earth-themed soundtrack and stunning tile designs. Explore over 250+ unique puzzle layouts, each more challenging than the last. Use the Combo meter to match quickly and earn stars. Climb the leaderboard for recognition and claim boosters by reaching the top. Immerse in the relaxing soundtrack and earthy tiles for a truly calming experience!

title: Christmas sorting
description:
Christmas Sorting is a relaxing game for all ages. Place objects next to each other to collect 3 identical objects in a row.
Collect all the unique decorations for a Christmas atmosphere.
Create Christmas coziness, decorate the Christmas tree the way you want.

title: UFO Attack
description: UFO Attack is a type of classic style arcade game, developed with Construct 3, abduct as many humans and pets as possible before they take you down, ideal for all ages.

title: Pirates Mahjong
description: Pirates Mahjong is a classic tile-matching game featuring challenging levels. Match pairs of pirate-themed tiles to clear the board, solve puzzles, and uncover hidden tiles along the way. Perfect for puzzle enthusiasts and pirate fans alike, Pirates Mahjong offers endless fun and excitement on the high seas!

title: Pesky Moles
description:
An ordinary farmer lived a quiet life and grew vegetables, but at some point, moles began to attack his garden and eat the entire crop.
After the next harvest, he decides to take everything into his own hands and protect his garden.
In Pesky Moles, you have to protect your garden from moles for a certain amount of time. The more pests you manage to neutralize and the more crops you save, the more coins you get. With the coins you earn, you can buy traps that will help you protect your garden.

title: Flick Shot Soccer
description: Flick Shot Soccer is a fun and addictive soccer shooting game where every goal is all about precision. Simply drag to aim and position your shot, then release to kick and send the ball flying into the net. Easy controls make it perfect for anyone to pick up and play, while smart angles and timing are needed to score consistently.

title: Match Factory
description: Welcome to Match Factory - the most relaxing and non-stop casual triple puzzle game. Step into a vibrant factory full of colorful items, and play the role of a master matcher. Match three identical items to clear them from the board, pack them up, and keep the factory running smoothly! Every level is uniquely designed with tricky layouts and challenges. Use power-ups that help you overcome difficult puzzles!

title: Knit Bears
description: Knit Bears is a cozy and colorful puzzle game where you help adorable teddy bears come to life by knitting them from soft yarn. Choose a bear, place it in the center, and matching yarn balls will start wrapping it up. Each teddy bear needs three yarns to be fully knitted, so plan your moves carefully. If the board fills with unfinished bears that can’t be completed, the game ends.

title: Draw Bridge Puzzle
description: Draw Bridge Puzzle is a creative and exciting puzzle game that combines drawing and rescue gameplay into one addictive experience. You become a bridge designer, using your finger to draw safe paths and complete thrilling rescue missions. Enter the car mode, draw a strong bridge to help a motor cross gaps, broken roads, and dangerous obstacles to reach the goal.

title: Candy Smash
description: Candy Smash is a lively and addictive puzzle game where players tap on clusters of sweet candies to clear them and rack up points. Plan your moves wisely to clear the board and set new high scores before your lives run out! Featuring bright, colorful graphics and a delightful candy-themed world, this match-and-clear adventure is perfect for players of all ages.

title: Dalgona Game2
description:
There's a cute shape on the dalgona, a snack from the past.
Be careful not to break the shape.
It's complete if you take it out nicely in a pretty way to go!

title: 2 Player Games Design Salon
description: The Creative Showdown is officially underway! In the 2 Player Games Design Salon, you’ll compete in a real-time design contest against another player, with aesthetics and creativity determining the winner. Every round introduces a new artistic task packed with fun surprises. Built around expressive design gameplay, the experience stays relaxing yet competitive, making it a perfect casual multiplayer challenge.

title: 2-3-4 Player Games
description: These games can be played with 2, 3, or 4 players. You can play 21 unique games with your friends, each with different scenarios. The objective of each game is to either score or be the first to reach the finish line. Move swiftly and outpace your opponents! It's time to enjoy with friends!

title: Wolf Life Simulator
description:
Wolf Life Simulator: A Realistic Animal Simulation Game
Explore the life of a wolf in Wolf Life Simulator, the most realistic animal simulation game ever! Become a wolf and learn how to survive, hunt, mate, and fight against other predators. Experience the thrill of the wild in this exciting wildlife game. Are you ready for the adventure? Try Wolf Life Simulator now and have fun!

title: Tropical Cubes 2048
description: A game in the genre of 2048. Skillfully use the game physics to your advantage. The goal of the game is to connect the cubes to the maximum number 2048 and not to lose. There is a booster in the game, which will make it fun and easier to pass the game.

title: K-Pop Hunters Valentine Style
description: K-Pop Hunters Valentine Style brings romance, fashion, and K-pop glamour together in one stylish dress-up experience. Help your favorite K-pop hunters transform their looks for Valentine’s Day with stunning outfits, flawless makeup, and charming accessories.

title: Mob Rush
description: Fun and strategy unite under one roof. Navigate a path filled with obstacles and guide your army through the right gates. Multiply your units and conquer enemy territory. Defend your empire and advance to the next level. Victory or defeat!

title: Vibe Colouring
description: Relax with your favorite color by number game! Paint hundreds of pictures — from funny memes to calm landscapes. Every drawing is a little story that comes to life with your colors. Over 100 levels already in the game, and the library keeps growing. All pictures are open and free — no limits or waiting. Hints will show you where uncolored areas are hiding. Check the leaderboard to see who colored the most areas.

title: Boss Market
description: You are the owner of your market. Customers are coming to buy various products. Collect these products and place them into correct stands so that customers can buy them. Collect money from customers and open new markets and become a market boss!

title: Shadow Stickman Fight
description: Shadow Stickman Fight is an awesome and intense 2D ninja survival arcade game. You have to survive the endless waves of enemies with stickman ninjas. Every time you pass a belt exam, you get the examiner’s hat and weapon. You can use souls to trade items or earn gifts. You have to follow the white dots and hit the enemies. You have to time your attack when enemies are in your attack distance. You can also enter the arsenal and choose different equipment, like helmets and weapons.

The brave Granny who grows her cactuses on the road (so that they can receive rays of light) should protect them from aliens. She discovered that the aliens are afraid of human pills, and she has a huge amount of them, as well as a shotgun loaded in case of emergency.

title: Fireside Solitaire
description:
Fireside Solitaire is a cozy card puzzle that combines logic and relaxation by the warmth of a crackling fire.
Place cards in sequence — one rank higher or lower than the current open card — to clear all columns.
Think ahead: once the draw pile runs out, it can’t be reshuffled, and the game ends.
Enjoy calm music, soft light, and the comforting atmosphere of a winter evening by the fireplace.

title: Brick Match
description: Brick Match is a fast, fun puzzle game! Tap to match colorful bricks, trigger combos, and beat brain-teasing levels. Use boosters like the Shuffle, Colour Bomb, Extra Moves, and Row Blaster to blast through tough spots. Can you clear the board and beat your high score?

Drag and drop various shaped blocks onto a 9×9 grid to complete full rows, columns, or 3×3 squares to clear the board and earn high scores. Use strategy and planning to avoid running out of space and test your brain with every move!

title: Magic Tri Peaks Solitaire
description: Magic Tri Peaks Solitaire is the classic one lower one higher solitaire you know and love. The constantly changing locations and new cards on the board will keep you on your toes using new strategies. Don't expect to be an expert if you don't play for a couple weeks!

description: Obby Rainbow Tower is a fast, winter-themed tower race where every second and every jump matters. Each floor is packed with moving platforms, icy tiles, spinning lava bars, surprise snowstorms and snowball portals that try to knock you into the void.  You can replay the tower as many times as you like, trying to beat your own best time or racing a friend side by side in 2 player mode.

title: Bomber Battle Arena
description: Bomber Battle Arena is an exciting 3D collecting game that lets you play as a bomb-wielding character. Your goal is to strategically detonate bombs to clear various green plants and tree stumps, collect a golden key, and reach the treasure chest to advance to the next level. Be careful of the bomb’s blast radius and avoid contact with other monsters along the way. Get ready for an explosive adventure through 10 challenging levels full of explosive action!

title: Underwater Survival
description:
Dive Into a Mysterious and Beautiful Underwater World
Welcome to an unforgettable underwater survival adventure where exploration, discovery, and survival come together in a stunning ocean environment. Dive deep into a vibrant and mysterious sea filled with hidden secrets, breathtaking visuals, and endless possibilities.

title: Nubik: Create Your Place
description:
Nubik: Create Your Place – a game about Nubiks. In this game, you can create your own 'place' – meaning your own game. Choose the game type, build a level from blocks, set Nubik spawn points, and play.

You can play the game solo or with a friend. However, you can also create a 'place' (game) and simply watch how Nubiks (bots) play it.

The game features many skins for Nubiks, achievements, a leaderboard, and chat.

title: Dreamy Home
description:
It's not just a game, but a warm and peaceful adventure that helps you feel the magic of ordinary moments.
Opening box after box, you will find personal items and lovingly find the perfect place for them. Room by room, step by step, you will assemble mosaics of memories and emotional stories hidden in simple objects.

title: Brawl Stars Battle
description: Brawl Stars Battle is an exciting action shooting game where you control powerful heroes armed with guns and special abilities to defeat opponents in fast-paced combat! Select 3v3 battle mode and fight alongside your teammates. The team that kills fifteen opponents first wins. Use guns and powerful abilities in intense battles.

title: Aqua Sort: Water Color Puzzle
description: Dive into the relaxing world of Aqua Sort: Water Color Puzzle! Your goal is simple: sort the colored liquids into the flasks until each flask contains only one color. With over 1000 levels and unique modes like Color Fusion, Mystery, and Time Trial, this puzzle game will test your logic and patience. Unlock new themes and achievements as you play!

title: Peg Solitaire
description: Engage your mind with the classic puzzle game, Peg Solitaire. The objective is simple yet challenging: clear the board by jumping pegs over each other until only one peg remains. This timeless game tests your strategic thinking and planning skills, offering various levels of difficulty to keep you entertained.

title: Smashdoll
description:
Smashdoll – Ragdoll Smash Game is a fast and chaotic physics game where you smash through floors, obstacles, and enemies to reach the bottom! Collect coins, dodge bullets, and upgrade your smash power, jump force, and trails.

Break enough floors to charge your smash meter and transform into an unstoppable bullet of destruction. How far can you smash?

title: Shadowman Runner
description:
Shadowman Runner is a dark, atmospheric endless runner inspired by the minimalist silhouette style of Limbo and the fast-paced arcade spirit of games like Soul Knight and Alto’s Adventure. Set in a mysterious black-and-shadow world, the game challenges your reflexes, timing, and focus.
You play as a lone runner sprinting through a dangerous jungle landscape. Your goal is simple yet addictive: run as far as you can, collect potions to score points, and survive.

title: Winter Wolf
description: Winter has come, and the snowfall has begun. Since it's Christmas time, the wolf must find three stars during the winter. The wolf needs to carefully hunt and catch three sheep, take their stars, and gather all the bones on the path to avoid starving. It must also be cautious of the hunters in the forest. At the end of the level, it must reach the dark portal to teleport to its desired location.

title: ASMR Pet Treatment
description: Take care of your adorable puppy and kitty in this relaxing ASMR game! Wash, heal, and pamper your pets with gentle treatments. After they feel happy and healthy, have fun dressing them up in cute outfits. Relaxing sounds and sweet pets make every moment enjoyable!

title: Color Sort: Impostor Edition
description: Color Sort Impostor Edition is a fun and relaxing puzzle game that challenges your logic and focus. Sort the colorful characters into the correct tubes so that each tube contains only one color. The rules are simple, but the puzzles quickly become more challenging as new colors and obstacles appear. Plan your moves carefully, avoid mistakes, and enjoy a smooth, satisfying sorting experience designed for players of all ages.

title: Block Pixels
description:
Block Pixels is a vibrant puzzle game where classic block-clearing action meets the creative joy of pixel art discovery.

Your main goal is to strategically place colorful pieces to clear lines on the board. But the real magic lies in what you clear. Each block you eliminate contributes to a larger masterpiece. Clearing specific colors helps you build and reveal dozens of charming hidden images, from cute animals to fun objects.

title: Vex Hyper Dash
description:
Get ready for a fast-paced challenge in this brand-new Vex spin-off: Vex Hyper Dash! Inspired by the legendary Geometry Dash. Your goal is simple: survive as long as possible. Jump from platform to platform, time your moves perfectly, and avoid the countless dangers that stand in your way. One wrong move, one mistimed jump, and it’s game over. 

Vex Hyper Dash puts your reflexes and precision to the ultimate test. Can you master the flow and set a new high score?

title: ASMR Girl: Livestream Mukbang
description: Step into the world of ASMR Girl: Livestream Mukbang, where you take on the role of an adorable mukbang streamer! Get ready to indulge in delicious food, satisfy your cravings, and share the experience with your viewers in a cozy, interactive livestream. The more you eat and engage, the more you earn!

title: Crash the Robot!

An addictive physics puzzle game, the goal of which is to crash the robot on each level in all sorts of ways or give him the opportunity to do so himself. Arrange items from your inventory and trigger a chain of events to reach the goal! Also use cannons and jumppads.

The game has over 50 levels +5 bonus levels!

Fast Mode: Find the different figure in record time.
Relax Mode: Enjoy a calm and relaxing game, no pressure.
Extreme Mode: Test your skills with a real challenge.
